title: Graphic Designer (Apparel, Illustration and Typography)
description:
Basics:

- Location: Remote (Philippines)

- Working Time: Monday-Friday, 7am-4pm Philippine time (1 hour lunch break)

- Salary: PHP 40,516 / month

- Benefits: 10 paid holidays, 10 paid vacation days, 3 paid sick days

- Position Title: Graphic Designer

- Start Date: ASAP



Job Description:

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented designer who can create original, eye-catching apparel graphics, with strong illustration and typography skills and a portfolio to match. You should have a strong eye for apparel design and an understanding of fitness style trends (especially in the Australian market and globally). You must have strong English communication skills for direct client interaction and be able to deliver high-quality designs on time.



You will be creating the kinds of designs The Move Better Project prints on shirts and other apparel.



- Design original 2D graphics for t-shirts and other apparel, including illustration and custom lettering

- Apply 2D designs to 3D mock-ups as needed

- Redraw or trace logos as required

- Understand and interpret design briefs accurately

- Handle client revisions and feedback directly

- Communicate effectively with the internal team



Requirements:

- Strong portfolio showing apparel or shirt graphics, illustration and typography (lettering, wordmarks)

- 1-3 years of experience in apparel or graphic design

- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator (experience with Procreate or similar is a plus)

- Bachelor's degree in graphic design or a related field preferred

- Preferred experience working with Trello and Google Workspace

- Strong communication, conceptual thinking and design skills



Ideal Candidate:

- Creative, with a distinct illustration and lettering style, and able to adapt it to the client's brand

- Able to work independently without much oversight. Problem solver.

- Strong research skills, able to stay updated on current apparel and fitness style trends, particularly in the Australian market and globally

- Strong communicator, willing to stand up for their ideas and solutions

- Motivated to grow their skills and advance their career

- Reliable with strong attendance and commitment to consistent work



About Our Company:

P1peline is a digital services agency. We provide a range of services for our clients and internal brands.

For this role, the Graphic Designer will be hired and managed by P1peline but will work full-time with The Move Better Project, a fast-growing merchandise company specializing in custom shirts and other apparel printing. title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor — Storage Unit / Reselling Content (POV Vlog Style)
description:
Type: Part-time to full-time, long-term (remote, Philippines-based)

Pay: $400–$600/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise

Start: Paid test edit ($10–$20) before any commitment



About the content

I buy storage units at auction and film the entire process. Each finished video is 15–20+ minutes and follows this format:

1. Intro to camera — "I just bought this unit for $X, let's see what I found."

2. POV searching footage — the bulk of the video is shot on Meta smart glasses and a body cam while I dig through the unit, narrating what I'm finding in real time.

3. Value reveals — as items are found, big on-screen text pop-ups show what they're worth ("$87!"), sold eBay comp screenshots appear on screen, and money sound effects (ka-ching) play.

Think treasure-hunt / unboxing vlog pacing: the hook is the discovery, the payoff is the value reveal.

Style reference

Harrison Nevel on YouTube — same genre (buying storage units at auction, going through them on camera). His videos are very polished, pro-level work with a cameraman; I don't expect that level, but he's the right reference for the format: intro hook, searching footage, and value reveals. Example: "I Risked $1020 On An Abandoned Storage Unit..." — 

Aim for a solid, watchable version of that energy: clean cuts, clear value pop-ups, and pacing that keeps people watching.

What you'll do

• Cut 1–3 hours of raw multi-camera footage down to a tight 15–20 minute video

• Aggressively cut dead air and boring searching — keep the pacing snappy

• Add animated value pop-ups, sold eBay comp screenshots (I provide the comps and values, you place and style them), and money sound effects

• Background music that fits the energy without overpowering narration

• Light color/exposure matching between camera sources (Meta glasses, body cam, intro camera)

• Strong hooks — the first 30 seconds need to sell the video

• Export in 1080p (YouTube-ready), organized project files

Requirements

• 2+ years editing YouTube content (vlog, unboxing, POV, or creator-style — not corporate)

• Expert in Premiere Pro (After Effects or CapCut Pro a plus)

• Strong sense of pacing: you know when to cut, when to linger on a find, when to drop a sound effect

• Good written English for on-screen text

• Portfolio with at least 2–3 examples of creator-style or vlog editing

• Reliable internet and your own editing setup

How to apply

1. Send a link to your portfolio (YouTube links preferred)

2. Tell me your editing software and how many years you've been editing creator content

3. Answer: what's your process for keeping a 15-minute vlog video engaging from start to finish?

Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid test edit ($10–$20): a short segment of real footage to edit in the style described above. This is the main thing I hire on — show me the pacing, the pop-ups, and the sound design.

title: Creative Strategist - DTC and Meta Paid Social
description:
About the Role

This is a strategy-first role. You will own the creative thinking for two to three DTC accounts — the desires we go after, the avatars we speak to, the angles we test, the concepts that carry them, and the briefs that get them made.

You do not edit video, design statics, or buy media. You will occasionally build reference frames so an editor can see what you mean, but execution is not your job. D
 what gets made, and why, is.

Most of the work sits in health, wellness, and supplements, with room to expand into other e-commerce categories. It is a crowded, compliance-tight space where the gap between a winning ad and a dead one is almost always the angle, not the production quality.



Work Structure & Requirements

Schedule: Central European Time

Compensation: 8 USD per hour **negotiable



Key Responsibilities

1. Creative Strategy

Start from the desire the product actually serves, not the feature list

Identify the core avatar and sub-avatars underneath it, defined by what they have already tried and why it failed them

Turn those into testable angles, then into concepts, then into briefs — three different things, and you brief all three

Maintain a pipeline across angles, formats, hooks, and offers, with a stated reason for every test

Balance net-new concepts against iterations of proven winners

2. Brief Writing

Produce 5–15 briefs per client per week depending on scope, across short-form video, UGC, statics, and native-style formats

Every brief ships ready to execute: hook and opening concept, core message, script or talking points, visual direction, CTA, required assets, and editing notes

Write scripts yourself — an editor should never have to come back and ask what you meant

3. Research

Mine Amazon reviews (positive and negative) for the words customers actually use

Use Google searches to find what the market is confused about

Analyze Meta Ad Library and other ad libraries — what competitors are running, how long it has been live, and the technique underneath it rather than the line itself

Review competitor sites, offers, pricing, and landing pages

Pull voice of customer from Reddit, YouTube comments, ad comments, support tickets, and forums — their own sentence reads as recognition; a paraphrased problem reads as marketing

Identify what the market has already been told and already tried, so you stop repeating a claim it stopped believing

4. Performance Review & Recommendations

Come to performance reviews having already asked for the data you need — chasing the right numbers is part of the role

Diagnose why something won or lost specifically: was it the angle or the execution?

Recommend what to kill, what to iterate, and what to leave running — with the reasoning behind each call

Feed learnings directly into the next round of briefs

5. AI Integration

Use AI as part of your workflow for research, synthesis, ideation support, reference frames, and speeding up mechanical parts of the job

Hooks, angles, and scripts come from you — not AI



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 3+ years personally owning creative strategy for DTC paid social — in-house or agency; owning it, not contributing to it

Performance Mindset: You judge creative on hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and CPA/ROAS against a target — not on whether it looks good

Conceptual Clarity: You can explain the difference between a desire, an avatar, an angle, a concept, and a hook without hedging

Copywriting: Excellent written English and real copywriting ability — the hook is the job; you write UGC scripts yourself and brief editors and creators directly

Awareness Levels: You write for different levels of awareness and know why a hook that lands on someone already shopping falls flat on someone who hasn't named the problem yet

Iteration: You iterate deliberately — you know what to change in a winner and what to leave alone

Compliance: Comfortable inside a compliance-tight category; health and supplement claims live within real limits and you write inside them by instinct

Organization: Organized enough to carry two to three brands at once without dropping a deadline

Bonus: Agency experience, worked directly alongside Meta media buyers, experience with advertorials, VSLs, and long-form direct response



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, introduction video and portfolio

title: signage / wrap designer
description:
# Job Title: Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer



**Department:** Creative & Production



**Reports To:** Production Manager / Creative Director



**Job Type:** Full-Time



---



## Role Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly creative, and technical **Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer** to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-impact visual designs for full/partial vehicle wraps, commercial fleets, exterior/interior architectural signage, and large-format environmental graphics.



Unlike standard graphic design roles, this position requires a deep understanding of spatial geometry, 3D surface contours, scale, color management, and large-format print prepress. You will work directly with clients to translate their branding into real-world applications and collaborate with our print operators and installation technicians to ensure seamless execution.



---



## Key Responsibilities



### Design & Concept Creation



* Design custom, high-resolution graphics for partial and full vehicle wraps, fleet vehicles, window vinyl, wall murals, dimensional signage, and banners.

* Utilize specialized vehicle templates (e.g., Pro Vehicle Outlines, Badie) to precisely position graphics across complex 3D vehicle body contours, body seams, door handles, and windows.

* Build realistic 2D and 3D photo mockups for client approvals to accurately represent the final installed product.

* Interpret client branding guidelines, logos, and briefs to create eye-catching visual concepts that align with the client’s marketing goals.



### Prepress & Production File Preparation



* Convert approved concepts into precision, print-ready vector/raster files scaled at full size (1:1) or accurate architectural scale (e.g., 1:10).

* Set up print files with appropriate bleeds, overlapping panels, tiling, overlap seam allowances, and vector contour cut lines (CutContour).

* Ensure correct color profiling (CMYK, Pantone/PMS matching) and image resolution settings to prevent pixelation on large-format outputs.

* Nest cut graphics and print files efficiently to minimize material waste during printing and cutting.





Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly creative, and technical Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-impact visual designs for full/partial vehicle wraps, commercial fleets, exterior/interior architectural signage, and large-format environmental graphics.



Unlike standard graphic design roles, this position requires a deep understanding of spatial geometry, 3D surface contours, scale, color management, and large-format print prepress. You will work directly with clients to translate their branding into real-world applications and collaborate with our print operators and installation technicians to ensure seamless execution.



---



## Qualifications & Skills



### Required



* **Experience:** 2–5+ years of proven graphic design experience specifically in the sign, large-format print, or vehicle wrap industry.

* **Software Proficiency:** Advanced mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (specifically **Adobe Illustrator** and **Adobe Photoshop**).

* **Technical Knowledge:** Strong understanding of vector graphics, raster resolution requirements (DPI vs. dimensions), scale calculations, and color theory (CMYK vs. RGB vs. Spot Colors).

* **Spatial Awareness:** Demonstrated ability to visualize flat 2D designs applied to complex 3D surfaces (curves, rivets, recessed panels).

* **Attention to Detail:** Meticulous approach to measurements, spell-checking, bleed allowances, and file organization.

* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication skills for presenting concepts to clients and technical handoffs to installers.

title: Show Me an AI Video You Made That Got Real Views - AI Video Creator ($500/mo + Up To $500 Per Winner)

- Work in volume, because most videos fail and winners come from testing a lot



THE DEAL

- $500/month base

- Bonuses of up to $500 for each ad of yours that becomes a winner, paid in tiers as it grows. You are told the target for each niche before you start

- Remote



WHAT TO SEND

1. First line: the live link to your best AI video, with its view count.

2. One or two more live links if you have them, with view counts.

3. Proof it is yours: a screenshot of the analytics from the account or ad account, or a short screen recording of you logged in to it. If a client owns the account and you cannot get in, say so and tell me how else you can prove you made it.

title: Part-Time Real Estate Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - Australian Agent (20 hrs/week, Manila afternoons)
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Hi, I'm Nargis, a real estate sales consultant with Ray White Cranbourne in Melbourne, Australia. I sell homes right across Melbourne's south-east.



I need a friendly, reliable caller to phone homeowners from my own contact lists. Many of these people had an appraisal with us before, or told us they might sell later. Your job is to have a polite, relaxed chat and book either a callback with me or a free property appraisal. I do all the follow-up myself. This is not hard-sell telemarketing.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call Australian homeowners from one call list at a time in a shared Google Sheet

- Use my scripts in a natural, friendly way

- Start every call by saying your first name and that you are calling on behalf of Nargis Khedri from Ray White

- End the call straight away if the person asks, and mark them "Do not contact"

- Book callbacks or appraisals into the time slots I give you each week, and
 me the details

- Record the outcome of every call in the sheet and send a short end-of-day report



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 4 hours a day: 12:00 pm - 4:00 pm Philippine time (3:00 pm - 7:00 pm Melbourne time).

Melbourne is 3 hours ahead of Manila until early April, then 2 hours ahead, so your Manila start time will change by 1 hour then. No work on weekends or Australian public holidays.



PAY AND TRIAL

- US$5.00 per hour, paid weekly after the week is worked, through OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay (Payoneer or PayPal)

- US$10 bonus for each appraisal you book that actually goes ahead

- 1-month paid trial. If it goes well, the role continues ongoing.

- Shortlisted applicants will do a 15-minute paid role-play test (US$10).



REQUIREMENTS

- Cold calling or appointment-setting experience calling Australian or US customers (real estate experience is a plus)

- Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English

- A quiet room with no background noise

- Stable internet (include a speed-test screenshot) plus a backup (mobile data, pocket WiFi or UPS for brownouts)

- A good noise-cancelling headset

- Comfortable using Google Sheets and

- Honest and careful with private information. You will work only inside the shared sheet. No downloading, copying or saving of contact details.



HOW TO APPLY (all required)

1. Start your application with the code word: SOUTH EAST

2. Attach a 1-2 minute voice recording (Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom link is fine) where you:

   a) Read this script: "Hi, is that Sarah? Hi Sarah, it's [your name] calling on behalf of Nargis Khedri from Ray White Cranbourne. Nargis did an appraisal on your home about a year ago and asked me to check in and see how things are going. Have you got a minute?"

   b) Then answer in your own words: Why do you want to work in real estate calling?

3. Tell me briefly about your cold calling experience: which country, what you called about, and about how many calls per day.

4. Include your internet speed-test screenshot and tell me what headset and backup internet you use.

5. Confirm you can work 12:00 pm - 4:00 pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday.



Applications without the code word or the voice recording will not be reviewed.



Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Nargis

title: QA Automation Engineer (Playwright) - Healthcare SaaS Startup
description:
ABOUT US

MedSpot is an AI-powered healthcare and medical platform. We are building a modern, HIPAA-aligned EMR and practice-management system connected to a growing network of physicians and clinics: patient records, scheduling, charting, billing, pharmacy ordering, telehealth and AI-assisted clinical workflows. We are a small, fast-moving US-led startup with a real product in the hands of early practitioners, and we want a quality-minded teammate who will grow with us.



THE ROLE

You will own quality for the platform. We need someone who can work close to fully autonomously: you find the problems, build the tests, report clearly, and suggest how we can ship better, without waiting to be told what to do. You will work directly with the founder and the engineering team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and maintain end-to-end test suites in Playwright (TypeScript) for our Next.js web app: practitioner signup, patient records, scheduling, billing/invoices, pharmacy ordering and AI features

- Test REST APIs and verify data accuracy (totals, statuses, labels, permissions)

- Run regression passes before each release and wire automated tests into CI

- Do exploratory testing and catch what scripted tests miss

- Write clear, reproducible bug reports (steps, expected vs actual, screenshots or video, console/network logs)

- Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to write tests and triage faster

- Proactively improve our QA process, tooling and release checklist



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years in QA automation; Playwright preferred (Cypress/Selenium with willingness to switch is fine)

- Solid JavaScript/TypeScript, Git, and API testing (Postman or similar)

- Excellent written English; able to work independently with minimal supervision

- Detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable owning outcomes



NICE TO HAVE

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions), basic SQL, healthcare/HIPAA or regulated-software experience, testing of AI/LLM features



IMPORTANT

You will work on a staging environment with synthetic data only. No real patient data. Basic HIPAA/security training will be provided.



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short note on your QA automation experience, plus a link or description of a test suite you have built. Process: short screening call, then a paid take-home test (Playwright tests + a bug report).



SCHEDULE AND PAY

Full time, long-term role with room to grow. Some overlap with US Eastern morning hours preferred.

As we grow, our Sales Team plays a key role in helping customers make the right decisions, recover missed opportunities, and maximize the value of every customer interaction.



We're looking for driven sales professionals who want to be part of a growing team, take ownership of their results, and play a direct role in Plateful's continued growth.



The Opportunity



We're looking for driven, persistent, and consultative Outbound Sales Reps who can turn warm customer interactions into revenue and maximize every sales opportunity. You'll connect with customers at different stages of their buying journey, from those who showed strong intent but didn't complete their purchase, to existing customers who have just placed an order. Your role is to reconnect, understand their needs, overcome objections or payment concerns, and confidently guide them toward the right solution.



This includes recovering abandoned carts and declined transactions, as well as identifying post-purchase upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Every customer you speak with has already interacted with our brand, visited our store, attempted to purchase, or recently completed an order.

This is not cold calling. You'll be working with warm leads and existing customers, making every conversation an opportunity to recover a sale, increase order value, and create a better customer experience.



We're looking for people who build trust quickly, communicate confidently, and genuinely enjoy the challenge of turning customer conversations into successful outcomes.



Requirements

Read these carefully before applying:



* Strong upsell and cross-sell skills are non-negotiable. Recovering the sale is the baseline. The ability to grow order value and maximize every customer opportunity is where you win. 

* Proven experience in sales recovery, win-back, retention, upselling, or cross-selling, ideally in a consultative or high-ticket sales environment. $1K+ AOV experience is preferred. 

* Shopify and CRM experience is a must. You should be comfortable navigating orders, carts, and customer records without hand-holding. 

* Must be comfortable working EST hours, including night shifts and rotating weekday schedules. Shift start times may vary. 

* Excellent objection handling and closing skills. You should be comfortable handling price concerns, payment issues, hesitation, and other barriers to purchase. 

* Clear, confident, and persuasive communicator who can build trust quickly and guide customers toward a purchase decision. 

* KPI- and performance-driven with a strong ownership mindset. You track your numbers, understand your targets, and take responsibility for your results. 

* Fast learner, coachable, and execution-focused. You take feedback well and can quickly apply it to improve your performance.



Compensation & Benefits



* Fully Remote Position 

* Competitive Base Salary 

* Uncapped 5% Commission During Your First Month 

* Tiered Commission Structure From Month 2 Onwards 

* Daily Spiffs & Performance Incentives

Paid Leave Benefits

title: Senior Accountant / Finance Executive (Remote)
description:

We are looking for an experienced accountant to independently manage our day-to-day accounting operations, ensure financial accuracy and maintain organised financial records.

- Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces or service-based businesses.

title: Google Business Profile Outbound Caller / Specialist
description:

This is an urgent hire, and we are looking for someone who can start on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.



This is a calling-heavy role, so we are looking for someone who is confident speaking with people over the phone, following up consistently, overcoming hesitation, and getting people to complete their next step.



You will contact prospective and interested haulers, explain how the process works, collect the information we need, schedule verification calls or walkthroughs, and follow up until the profile is successfully created and verified.



You will also assist with Google Business Profile setup, optimization, verification issues, and ongoing profile management.



This is not a role for someone who only knows basic GBP optimization. We need someone who understands Google Business Profiles and is comfortable getting on the phone every day.



Key Responsibilities



- Outbound Calling & Hauler Follow-Up

- Make outbound calls to prospective and interested U.S.-based haulers.

- Explain our Google Business Profile setup and verification process clearly and confidently.

- Qualify haulers and determine whether their business/location meets GBP requirements.

- Collect required business information and supporting documentation.

- Schedule video verification sessions, walkthroughs, and follow-up calls.

- Guide haulers through what they need to prepare for verification.

- Follow up consistently with haulers who have not completed their next step.

- Handle common questions, concerns, and objections professionally.

- Keep conversations moving toward a clear next action.

- Maintain accurate notes after every call and interaction.



Google Business Profile Setup & Verification



- Create and configure Google Business Profiles.

- Work with both service-area businesses and location-based businesses.

- Set up categories, services, business hours, contact details, service areas, website links, and other profile information.

- Review locations and business information for GBP eligibility before proceeding.

- Guide haulers through Google verification requirements, including video verification when required.

- Troubleshoot failed or delayed verification attempts.



Suspensions & Reinstatements



- Identify possible causes of profile suspensions or restrictions.

- Correct underlying profile issues before submitting appeals.

- Gather legitimate supporting documentation.

- Submit reinstatement or appeal requests when required.

- Track cases and follow up with Google until resolved.



Profile Management & Optimization



- Monitor profiles for verification issues, unexpected edits, duplicates, inaccurate information, or suspensions.

- Keep listings complete and accurate.

- Optimize relevant categories, services, descriptions, photos, and other profile elements.

- Assist with review monitoring and responses.



Identify opportunities to improve local visibility and customer conversion.



Tracking & Follow-Up



Maintain an organized tracker showing:



- Hauler/business name

- Contact information

- Current GBP status

- Last contact

- Call outcome

- Verification status

- Open issues

- Next action

- Follow-up date



You are expected to take ownership of your pipeline and follow up without needing repeated reminders.



Requirements



To be considered, you must have:



- Strong outbound calling experience, preferably speaking with U.S.-based customers, contractors, business owners, or leads.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confidence speaking on the phone and guiding people through a process.

- Experience following up with leads until an action is completed.

- Hands-on experience with Google Business Profiles.

- Experience creating and verifying Google Business Profiles.

- Understanding of service-area businesses and location-based businesses.

- Familiarity with Google Business Profile verification requirements.

- Ability to troubleshoot GBP problems independently.

- Strong organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple haulers/profiles simultaneously.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional environment for making calls.

- Availability for 40 hours per week, including scheduled calls during U.S. business hours.



Must be available to start Wednesday, October 28, 2026.



Strong Plus



- Experience handling GBP suspensions and reinstatement appeals.

- Experience with U.S. home-service businesses.

- Local SEO experience.

- Citation management or citation audit experience.

- Previous experience working with contractors, junk removal companies, haulers, movers, landscapers, or other local service businesses.

- Experience working with CRM or lead-management systems.



Success in This Role Means



You are successful when:



Calls are consistently completed and properly documented.

Haulers understand exactly what they need to do next.

Follow-ups happen without management having to remind you.

Interested haulers continue moving through the process instead of getting stuck.

Verification appointments are scheduled and completed.

Profiles are created accurately and successfully verified.

GBP issues are identified and addressed quickly.

Your pipeline and tracker are always current and organized.



How to Apply



We are reviewing applications immediately and plan to hire someone who can start on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. Please only apply if you are available to start on that date.



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short summary of your outbound calling experience, including the types of customers or leads you have called.

2. A short summary of your Google Business Profile experience, including approximately how many profiles you have personally created, verified, or managed.

3. Describe your experience with GBP video verification, suspensions, or reinstatement appeals, if applicable.

4. Tell us how you normally handle a prospect who is interested but keeps delaying the next step.

5. Submit a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your relevant experience. Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.

Nice to have

title: Australian Healthcare Bookkeeper (Xero) | Axis Imaging
description:
Remote from the Philippines · Working with our Melbourne team



Axis Imaging is a diagnostic imaging business based in Mickleham, Victoria. Our clinic provides CT, ultrasound, X-ray and bone density scans. As we prepare to open more sites, we’re looking for a bookkeeper to own our day-to-day accounts in Xero and work directly with the owners and our Australian accountant.



Each week, the owners need to know how much cash is available, what’s due before the next pay run, and which items need their attention. You’ll keep the books current, investigate differences and give us a short, clear update we can act on.



What you’ll own



• Bank reconciliations. Reconcile bank and credit card transactions in Xero each week. Match clinic receipts against billing reports and follow up on differences.

• Bills and payments. Manage the accounts inbox, match invoices to supporting records, check for duplicates and prepare payment batches for approval.

• Payroll support. Check fortnightly timesheets against payroll inputs, flag discrepancies before the pay run and reconcile payroll accounts afterward.

• Weekly cash reporting. Summarise cash balances, upcoming payroll and supplier payments, overdue receipts and any decisions the owners need to make.

• Month-end close. Reconcile balance sheet accounts, maintain prepayment and accrual schedules, and prepare a monthly P&L with brief explanations for material changes. Work with our accountant on BAS preparation and queries.



What we’re looking for



You’ve managed bookkeeping for an Australian business in Xero and can take a set of books through month-end independently. You’re comfortable with GST coding, payroll reconciliations and Excel or Google Sheets. You communicate clearly, handle financial and payroll information confidentially, and follow up when you’re missing an invoice or approval. Experience in a medical, dental or allied health practice is a plus.



How to apply



Send your CV and a short note about an Australian business whose books you managed. Tell us which parts of the weekly and monthly bookkeeping you handled yourself.



Include one example of a reconciliation that didn’t balance. What was the discrepancy, how did you investigate it, and how did you resolve it? Please leave out client names and confidential details.



Let us know your availability, the hours you can overlap with Melbourne, and your expected monthly pay in PHP for those hours.

* Prioritize paid collaborations and commercially valuable opportunities.



2. Creator & Brand Research

* Assist with scheduling, campaign calendars, and internal coordination.

4. Reporting & Performance Tracking



* Provide consistent updates on outreach activity.

* Maintain accurate records of all pitching activity.

* Monitor response rates and identify opportunities to improve outreach strategies.

* Meet monthly pitching targets and maintain professional communication standards.



Monthly Performance Expectations



We are looking for someone who can consistently produce results rather than simply complete administrative tasks.



All monthly pitching targets are calculated per creator, not collectively across the agency’s roster.



Expected monthly output per creator:



* 100 pitches: Minimum monthly outreach requirement.

* 150 pitches: Preferred performance target.

* 200 pitches: Upper monthly target.



These targets apply individually to every creator assigned to the coordinator. For example, if you are assigned three creators, the minimum monthly requirement would be 300 pitches across those three creators.



All outreach must be personalized, relevant, and directed toward brands that genuinely align with our creators.



Quality matters just as much as quantity. Mass-produced, irrelevant, or repetitive pitches will not count toward performance expectations.



Compensation & Bonuses



Base Compensation: $350 USD per month.



This is a part-time freelance position with an expected commitment of approximately 25 hours per week.



Additional Performance Compensation



* 5% commission bonus: Earn 5% of the agency commission actually received from qualifying brand partnerships directly generated through your outreach efforts.

* Trial Month Performance Bonus: An additional $100 USD may be awarded at the end of the initial 30-day trial period based on overall performance, consistency, communication, organization, and achievement of assigned targets.

All compensation and bonuses will be processed through Upwork in accordance with its payment policies and the agreed contract terms.

The first 30 days will serve as an introductory evaluation period.



During this period, we will assess:



* Quality and consistency of brand outreach.

* Ability to meet pitching targets.

* Written English proficiency and professional communication.

* Organization and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

* Understanding of influencer marketing and brand partnerships.

Qualifications & Requirements



* Previous experience in influencer marketing, talent management, PR, brand outreach, or business development is preferred.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong professional
 communication skills.

* Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, influencer campaigns, and social media marketing.

* Experience with Google Workspace, Google Sheets, and
 management.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Reliable internet connection and consistent availability.

* Ability to dedicate approximately five hours per weekday.

 submissions are not permitted. Candidates must be comfortable researching brands and writing professional outreach independently.



Important Role Boundaries



This position focuses on brand outreach and internal talent coordination.

* Accept or decline brand partnership offers on behalf of the agency.

s you have personally written (with confidential information removed).

title: Founding Go-to-Market Lead — AI Products, Sales & Customer Growth
description:
# Founding Go-to-Market Lead — AI Products, Sales & Customer Growth



**Remote • Philippines • Brisbane business hours**



**What would you want to help build over the next two to five years?**



We’re looking for someone who wants to take real ownership of bringing AI products and services to market—shaping the offer, driving marketing, winning customers and helping those customers succeed.



We’re an Australian AI startup led by a founder with 25 years of business experience across multiple brands and international markets. Our work spans practical sales and marketing automation through to AI ecosystems for enterprise-sized businesses, including work in health clinics, childcare, real estate and logistics.



Our ambition goes beyond individual AI tools. We’re developing connected systems that bring together business knowledge, workflows and AI agents—a practical business “second brain” that helps teams achieve more.



We have customers to serve and products to develop across Australia, New Zealand and soon USA. Now we need a commercially capable person to help turn that foundation into repeatable growth.



## The role



You will work directly with the founder every day, including a short daily stand-up to agree priorities, review progress and resolve blockers.



We are a small technical team, so for you this is a hands-on role. You’ll help d
 what needs doing and personally move it forward.



You will:



- **Shape our offers:** understand customer problems and turn our capabilities into clear positioning, packages, demonstrations and proposals.

- **Take products to market:** help select promising customer segments, launch campaigns and test what generates demand.

- **Drive marketing:** create or coordinate social content, video and campaigns using AI tools and sound commercial judgement.

- **Build and manage sales:** prospect, qualify enquiries, run conversations, maintain the pipeline, follow up proposals and close business within agreed authority.

- **Support early customers:** coordinate onboarding, communicate clearly, follow through on commitments and identify opportunities to improve retention and expand accounts.

- **Inform product development:** bring customer evidence to the founder and technical team so we build what people need and will pay for.

- **Build repeatable processes:** establish practical routines in GoHighLevel and document what works as the team grows.



You will work alongside our founder and technical lead. You are not expected to be the sole engineer, designer and salesperson—but you must be willing to execute across the commercial work while we are small.



## What you must bring



- Evidence that you have helped launch, sell or grow a product or service—not simply held a relevant title.

- Experience working with Australian businesses or serving Australian customers, with an understanding of their communication and commercial expectations.

- Excellent spoken and written English, including confidence on customer calls and video meetings.

- The ability to turn an unclear opportunity into a practical plan and follow it through.

How to apply



1. Send a human introduction video—approximately three minutes.



Tell us:



Who you are and why this opportunity interests you.



The most relevant business, product or market you helped grow.



What you personally owned and what results you achieved.



Why you believe you should be shortlisted.



We welcome creativity. If you would also like to show an AI-generated video, product demonstration or another creative example, please do. Your application must still include you speaking as yourself. A straightforward phone or webcam recording is enough.



2. Provide evidence of your work.



Share one or two relevant examples covering:



The product, industry and market.



The starting situation and your responsibilities.



What you did, over what period, and the measurable result.



What a former manager or client could verify.



Redacted examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential client information.



3. Answer these questions briefly.



Which Australian businesses or customers have you worked with, and in what capacity?



What other industries or markets have you helped build or enter?



Which AI, GHL and video tools have you used, and what did you accomplish?



What changed in AI over the last six months that changed how you work?



What would you like to own or build over the next two to five years?



Can you maintain the Brisbane working hours described above?



Are you comfortable with occasional overseas business travel? This is optional, and being unable to travel will not exclude you. Any travel would be discussed and agreed separately.



What are your availability, other work commitments and expected compensation? Please state the currency.



Shortlisted candidates will take part in a live discussion, a defined paid practical exercise and reference checks.



Show us what you’ve built, how you think and what you’re ready to take responsibility for next.

ABOUT US



Optemate is a Pennsylvania-based web development and AI automation company. We give local service businesses (HVAC, auto repair, contractors, gyms, home services) a professionally built demo website for free. If the owner likes it, they pay $100/month to keep it live. If not, they owe nothing.



It’s a simple offer that’s easy to explain and easy to book.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Call business owners from qualified lead lists we provide. No prospecting needed.

Pitch the free demo website and book short demo calls on our team’s calendar.

Log calls in our tracker and hit 100+ dials per shift.



Our team handles the demos, closing, and any upsells like SEO, Google Business Profile, and automations. We provide a US calling number, lead lists, and call scripts.



SCHEDULE

Monday–Friday, 9 AM–1 PM US Eastern (20 hours/week). Fixed, not rotating.

In Philippine time, that’s 10 PM–2 AM during US standard time and 9 PM–1 AM during US daylight saving time.



These are the hours US business owners are most likely to answer.



PAY

$450/month base, paid twice monthly ($225 per payment) via Wise.

$8 per attended demo. The owner must join the call and stay at least 5 minutes. You earn it whether or not they buy.

$100 per new client, paid once their first payment clears. This applies to any client who signs within 30 days of a demo you booked.

$250 bonus every time 10 of your booked demos become paying clients.



Commissions are paid on the next pay date. Base pay starts on day one, including the two-week trial. Trial targets are 100+ dials per shift and 5 demos booked by the end of week two.

Performance Attended Demos Clients Monthly Earnings

Getting started 10 2 $730

Solid 15 4 $970

Strong 22 8 $1,426

GROWTH



We review performance at 90 days. Callers who consistently hit targets and convert demos move toward full-time hours and a higher base. We’re looking for a long-term working relationship.



REQUIREMENTS

At least 1 year of cold calling, appointment setting, or outbound sales to US businesses.

Clear spoken English, strong written English, and a confident phone presence.

Stable internet (25+ Mbps), a quiet workspace, and a headset with a microphone.

Comfortable with Google Sheets, Gmail, and calendar tools. CRM experience is a plus.

Able to work the 9 AM–1 PM ET shift every weekday.

Comfortable hearing “no” dozens of times per shift while staying friendly and professional.

HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with DEMO.

Include a screenshot of your internet speed from speedtest.net.

title: Executive Assistant to the Director | Fast-Growing Property Investment Business
description:

Charlie Property is a property investment, renovation and flipping business based in Geelong, Australia. Hours and engagement

title: Communications Manager
description:
Mop & Pop is a Dubai-based cleaning company working with holiday rental properties. We’re looking for an experienced Communications & Operations VA to manage day-to-day communication with property owners and their teams, and help keep our cleaning schedule running smoothly. 



This is a fast-paced role where timings change, guests check out late, and competing priorities need quick decisions. We need someone who takes ownership, checks the facts and speaks up when something doesn’t add up.



What you’ll do



Manage daily communication with property owners, property managers and their assistants.

Confirm checkout times, upcoming check-ins and access arrangements so our team can plan accurately.

Keep clients informed about cleaning progress, delays and any issues affecting a property’s readiness.

Respond quickly when guests haven’t checked out, access is unavailable, or plans change.

Make sure the relevant person contacts the guest when needed, and follow through until the issue is resolved.

Work closely with our cleaning team to understand availability, workloads and realistic completion times.

Learn each client’s properties, requirements and communication preferences.

Use cleaner performance rankings and property cleaning-time data to support practical decisions.

Spot potential scheduling problems early and suggest solutions before they affect the next job.

Keep clear, accurate records so everyone is working from the same information.



What we’re looking for



Previous experience in a similar communications or operations role within holiday rentals, property management, cleaning or hospitality.

Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally and firmly when needed.

Strong judgement and the confidence to question incorrect or incomplete information.

The ability to prioritise, think ahead and make practical decisions under pressure.

Close attention to detail, particularly around timings, property instructions and follow-ups.

Confidence working with data, schedules and performance information.

A reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working setup.

Availability for the full working hours, six days per week.



How you’ll succeed



You’ll need to understand how one delayed checkout can affect several cleans and incoming guests. Simply acknowledging a message isn’t enough: you’ll check what it means for the schedule, identify who needs to act and make sure the next step happens.



We value people who ask useful questions, flag concerns and recommend a better approach. If a checkout time looks wrong or a deadline is unrealistic, we expect you to raise it.



To apply



Please send your CV and a short explanation of your relevant experience, including the number of properties or daily jobs you’ve supported.



Working hours will be 8 am - 4 pm Dubai time zone.

title: Senior Ecommerce Marketing Manager – Beauty Brand (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
This is a long-term, full-time, work-from-home role with an ambitious, fast-growing Australian beauty brand.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Ecommerce Marketing Manager to own and accelerate the brand’s direct-to-consumer growth. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who can turn customer insight, creative ideas and performance data into stronger conversion, more efficient acquisition and sustained sales growth.



Focus: Ecommerce growth | Platform: Shopify | Channels: Paid, CRM and web



ABOUT THE BRAND



We are an age-positive Australian beauty brand creating high-performing, uncomplicated products for women who want beauty to feel relevant, joyful and real. We are building a distinctive brand with ambitious growth plans across Australia and international markets.



THE ROLE



You will lead the ecommerce growth engine across Shopify, paid media, CRM and onsite conversion. You will work closely with the social and creative teams to turn brand stories, customer problems and cultural moments into high-performing ads, hooks, landing pages and campaigns. You will be equally comfortable setting the strategy, briefing creative, managing activity in platform and digging into the numbers to d
 what happens next.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Ecommerce and Shopify ownership:

- Own the day-to-day performance and commercial growth of the brand’s Shopify store.

- Manage site merchandising, product launches, collections, promotions and campaign updates, ensuring the customer journey is seamless from landing page to checkout.

- Build and maintain a conversion optimisation roadmap across product pages, landing pages, bundles, offers, navigation, mobile experience and checkout.

- Use customer behaviour, site analytics and testing to identify friction, prioritise improvements and increase conversion rate and average order value.

- Coordinate developers and agency partners, writing clear briefs and ensuring work is delivered accurately and on time.



Paid media and profitable growth:

- Own paid performance strategy and execution across Meta and Google, including campaign structure, budgets, optimisation, testing and in-platform management.

- Set clear growth targets and manage spend against revenue, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, contribution margin and new-customer growth.

- Build a disciplined testing program across audiences, offers, formats, landing pages, hooks and creative concepts.

- Scale winning campaigns while protecting efficiency, and act quickly when performance changes.

- Translate channel data into clear actions and commercial recommendations for the leadership and wider team.



Creative strategy and campaign development:

- Work closely with social, brand and creative teams to build the advertising strategy, creative pipeline and campaign calendar.

- Develop sharp customer-led hooks, briefs and testing angles that connect the brand’s brand voice with clear product benefits and reasons to buy.

- Analyse creative performance to identify which messages, formats, talent and concepts drive sales, then feed those learnings back into content production.

- Write and refine on-brand copy for ads,
, landing pages and web campaigns.

- Ensure campaigns land consistently across paid ads, organic social,
, website and retail touchpoints.



CRM and customer growth:

- Own
 and CRM in Klaviyo, including campaign planning, automations, segmentation, testing, creative and reporting.

- Grow customer lifetime value through effective welcome, education, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and loyalty journeys.

- Use customer data and insights to improve retention, repeat purchase and the relevance of the brand’s communication.



Reporting, SEO and optimisation:

- Create a clear weekly trading and performance view covering revenue, traffic, conversion, average order value, channel efficiency, customer acquisition and retention.

- Own the digital trading rhythm, identifying risks and opportunities early and recommending the actions required to hit sales targets.

- Support SEO and content strategy, including the brand’s menopause and perimenopause education hub, working with agency partners and developers.

- Build a culture of testing and learning, with documented hypotheses, results and next steps.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- Consistent, profitable growth in online revenue and new-customer acquisition.

- Improved Shopify conversion rate, average order value and customer lifetime value.

- A reliable creative testing engine with a steady pipeline of new hooks and winning ad concepts.

- Stronger paid media efficiency and confident scaling of spend.

- Clear, actionable reporting that helps the team make faster commercial decisions.

- Well-executed launches and campaigns delivered seamlessly across all digital touchpoints.



ABOUT YOU



- Fluent English, spoken and written (essential)

- Senior ecommerce or growth marketing experience in a high-growth beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness or consumer brand, with a strong record of increasing online sales.

- Deep, hands-on Shopify experience and a strong understanding of ecommerce merchandising, customer journeys and conversion optimisation.

- Highly experienced in paid social and paid search, particularly Meta and Google, with the ability to manage campaigns directly rather than relying entirely on agencies.

- Experience applying proven ecommerce growth frameworks, with strong testing discipline and growth methodology.

- Strong Klaviyo and CRM experience across campaigns, automations, segmentation and retention strategy.

- A proven ability to use data to make decisions, prioritise activity and explain performance clearly to non-specialists.

- Strong creative judgement and experience partnering with social and creative teams to develop performance-led concepts, hooks and briefs.

- Excellent copywriting and communication skills, with a sharp understanding of brand tone and customer motivation.

- Commercially minded, highly organised and comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

- Proactive, accountable and calm under pressure, with the confidence to challenge, recommend and act.



HIGHLY REGARDED



- Experience growing a beauty brand across Australia and the United States.

- Experience with subscription, bundles, gifting, loyalty or referral programs.

- Working knowledge of GA4, attribution tools, dashboards, SEO and Shopify analytics.

- Experience managing agency, freelance and developer relationships.



HOW WE WORK



This role suits someone who loves pace, ownership and visible commercial impact. You will be expected to bring ideas, test them quickly, learn from the results and work generously across brand, creative, social and operations. Here, strong performance and strong brand building should reinforce each other.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send your CV and a short note outlining the ecommerce growth you have personally driven. Include examples of Shopify conversion improvements, paid media results, creative testing programs and the ecommerce growth frameworks you have used.

title: AI Video Creator & Editor / Web Designer (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
I'm Kenji, a business owner based in Germany. I'm looking for a full-time, remote AI Video Creator and Video Editor / Web Designer to help with two areas:



1. Marketing for a German e-commerce brand in the computer accessory space. This is mainly AI-generated product videos for Amazon and short-form social media content.

2. My web agency, where we build Wordpress websites for German clients using AI Tools like Claude Code/Codex.



Depending on what you're better at, you will do more of one or the other, and we will figure out the split together. Beginners are welcome, provided you have a great eye for design, detail-oriented, motivated, and fast at learning new things. 



Video tasks:

- Create and edit AI product videos for Amazon and social media, including short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Generate clips with AI video tools, add music etc.

- Edit videos

- Try out new AI tools and models



Web design tasks:

- Design and build websites for clients using AI

- Update and improve existing client websites



Requirements:

- Good eye for design and attention to detail

- Creative eye for pacing, visual storytelling and clean composition

- Interest in AI tools and prompting for video and image generation. Experience is a plus but not required

- Familiar with short-form video formats for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Able to think from the customer's point of view

- Good written English

- Stable internet connection

- Laptop or PC that can handle video editing



Nice to have:

- German language skills or understanding of German culture

- Experience with video editing

- Experience with web design

- Experience with local SEO is a plus

- Experience with AI video tools like Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance, Runway, Veo etc.

- Experience with AI Coding Agents like Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity

- Experience making product videos or ads for e-commerce brands

- Motion graphics or animation

- Experience with UGC-style videos or paid social ads

- Understanding of ad performance numbers and how to improve videos based on them



Schedule:

- 45 hours per week, Monday to Saturday

- At least 5 hours overlap with German business hours



Salary:

- Php 28,000 per month



What I offer:

- Long-term full-time position

- You work directly with me, no middle managers

- Flexible hours, as long as you have the 5 hours overlap with Germany

- work with latest AI agent tools

- Your work is seen by real customers on Amazon and on client websites



How to apply:

Please add the word "Agentic Engineering" in the subject of your application so I know you read the full post. Answer in this order:



1. About You

Name, age, location, current work situation, your CV.



2. Your Work

2–3 samples of your work (videos, designs, websites). If you're a beginner, anything that shows your eye is fine too, like tattoos you designed, photos, drawings or your own YouTube or TikTok channel. For each one, tell me what you did yourself and which tools you used.



3. Your Setup

Which AI tools, editing or design software you have used, details about your PC / Laptop and internet reliability and speed.



4. Mini Task (about 30–45 min)

There is no perfect answer, I want to see how you think and what you notice.



VIDEO TASK



The situation:

Imagine this is a new client project. The client is a brand that sells this vertical mouse on Amazon:



The listing has no product video yet, and they want one.



What you need to know:

- The video is shown on the Amazon product page. 30–45 seconds, 16:9

- The client gives us a 3D model of the mouse, so we can render clean product shots from any angle, with any camera movement

- Shots with real hands on a real desk can be filmed by us, or generated with AI video tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance)

- You can use product facts that are in the listing, if you want to show something that isn't there, write it down as a question for the client



Your task:

Make a storyboard for this video:

- One picture per shot. A photo of a quick drawing on paper you take a photo of is fine too, or images you made with an AI tool

- Imagine you are the creative director. Explain to me each scene, how the camera moves, the text on screen, what I can see as the customer watching the video.

- Any insights you were able to gather from the Amazon reviews that you feel like should be shown also in the video? Mention what

- Share the storyboard as a link, pdf, image etc.

The video can have a different style compared to the listing images if you have a better design vision, or could be same, the client is okay with either option.



WEB DESIGN TASK



The situation:

Imagine this new client: a roofing company (Dachdeckerei) in Munich, newly founded a month ago. The two founders are roofers who worked for a larger roofing company for over 10 years before starting their own business. One of them is a master roofer (Dachdeckermeister). They are a team of 4 and work in Munich and up to 30 km around it.



Their services: roof repairs, storm damage, roof renovation, flat roofs and gutters.

Their customers: mostly homeowners aged 40–70 who call when something is leaking, and property management companies (Hausverwaltungen) with apartment buildings.



They don't have a website yet, only a Google Business Profile with 6 reviews (all 5 stars). They have a logo, photos from their first jobs (taken with a phone), a phone number, WhatsApp and an
 address.



What they want: more inquiries, and to look like a solid, established business.



They send us this website as inspiration:



"I like this website. It looks honest and you can find the phone number right away. I'd like something similar."



Our first step: we take this website as the template for our client.



Your task (no need to design anything, just explain in words):

1. Go through the website from top to bottom. For each part, tell me if you would keep it, change it or remove it for our client, and why. If you change it, what exactly would you change?

2. What does our client need that the template doesn't have?

3. Any hidden assumptions or unclear points you want to challenge or clarify with the client first?



Please write it in your own words.

title: Product Manager (Technical) / Software Architect
description:
We are seeking a Technical Product Manager / Architect who bridges product design and engineering execution. This role combines system-level thinking, architectural oversight, and clear, actionable documentation—producing deliverables engineers can build from directly. The ideal candidate can translate business needs into architecture diagrams, wireframes, and well-scoped tickets with code-level precision, ensuring efficient handoff and reduced rework.



Requirements & Documentation

• Author architecture-aware product specifications including system diagrams, logic flows, and key technical dependencies.

• Prepare engineer-ready tickets, including pseudocode, scaffolding, or sample API structures.

• Conduct architecture and code reviews, identifying potential design or implementation issues early.

• Build wireframes, mockups, and interaction flows using Figma or equivalent tools to align engineering and UX/UI early in the cycle.

• Collaborate with engineering to ensure technical feasibility and architectural scalability before feature commitment.

Cross-Functional Execution

• Work closely with engineering leads to break down architecture into structured deliverables and sprint-ready tasks.

• Lead technical review sessions to validate assumptions and architecture decisions before coding begins.



Qualifications

• Strong understanding of software architecture principles, REST APIs, and modular system design.

• Hands-on experience writing or reviewing code in PHP, JavaScript, and SQL preferred.

• Proficiency in creating wireframes, prototypes, and UI flows that accurately reflect data and system constraints.

• Ability to evaluate trade-offs between architectural purity, delivery speed, and scalability.

• Prior experience functioning as a bridge between engineering and design, ensuring clarity and readiness for execution.

title: Student Accounts & Collections Officer
description:
Company: Alpha Technical Training

Employment Type: Part-time

Work Arrangement: Remote / Offshore

Industry: Vocational Education & Training (Australia)



ABOUT THE ROLE:



Alpha Technical Training is seeking a proactive, commercially minded Student Accounts & Collections Officer to manage outstanding student payments and maximise cash collection.



This is not a traditional payment reminder or administrative follow-up role.



We are looking for someone who knows how to have difficult financial conversations, negotiate payment arrangements, overcome objections and turn outstanding balances into successful collections.



Many of our students are working professionals completing trade qualifications. They may experience financial difficulties, competing priorities or delays in completing their payments.



Your responsibility is to understand their circumstances, identify practical solutions and negotiate mutually acceptable payment arrangements while maintaining positive student relationships.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Payment Recovery & Negotiation

- Proactively contact students with outstanding course fees.

- Understand the actual reasons behind delayed payments.

- Negotiate realistic payment arrangements within company-approved guidelines.

- Offer structured instalment plans where appropriate.

- Secure specific payment commitments, including amounts and dates.

- Follow through on commitments until payments are received.

- Identify opportunities to recover overdue balances earlier without placing unreasonable pressure on students.



2. Objection Handling & Problem Solving

- Confidently handle objections such as:

“I can’t afford to pay right now.”

“I’ll pay next month.”

“I’m waiting for my salary.”

“I’m too busy.”

“I’ll get back to you.”

- Ask effective questions to understand the student’s financial circumstances.

- Explore alternative arrangements rather than accepting the first objection.

- Identify genuine financial hardship and escalate cases requiring special consideration.

- Know when to negotiate, when to follow up and when to escalate.



3. Student Relationship Management

- Build trust and maintain professional relationships with students.

- Explain outstanding balances, payment deadlines and agreed arrangements clearly.

- Help students understand the administrative and contractual implications of outstanding payments without making misleading statements or threats.

- Maintain a supportive but commercially focused communication style.

- Resolve payment-related concerns and disputes professionally.



4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate payment notes and follow-up records in 
.

- Record objections, payment commitments, agreed instalments and next actions.

- Monitor overdue balances and broken payment arrangements.

- Provide daily collection reports and weekly cashflow forecasts.

- Identify students with high recovery potential and prioritise accordingly.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:



- Success in this role will be measured by:

- Total outstanding cash successfully collected.

- Percentage of overdue balances recovered.

- Payment commitments successfully converted into receipts.

- Number and value of realistic payment arrangements negotiated.

- Reduction in overdue account balances.

- Quality of student communication and compliance with collection procedures.

- We value actual collections and sustainable payment arrangements, not simply the number of calls made.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:



- Minimum 2 years’ experience in credit collection, accounts receivable, debt recovery or payment negotiation.

- Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident conducting payment discussions over the phone.

- Ability to build rapport while maintaining a clear collection objective.

- Commercial mindset with strong problem-solving ability.

- Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate records.

- Ability to work independently and achieve collection targets.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE:



- Experience collecting education or training fees.

- Experience working with Australian customers.

- Experience negotiating instalment arrangements.

- Familiarity with 
 or similar CRM platforms.

title: Remote Solar and Battery Sales Consultant - Australian Company
description:
About Us

Unplugged Energy is a dynamic and growing solar energy company based in Perth, Western Australia. We are passionate about helping homeowners switch to clean, renewable energy, saving them money and contributing to a greener planet. As demand for solar and batteries surges in Western Australia, we are expanding our sales team and looking for a motivated professional to join us.



The Opportunity

This is your chance to build a lucrative career in one of Australia's fastest-growing industries from the comfort of your home. We are seeking a results-driven and passionate Remote Solar & Battery Sales Consultant to join our high-performing team.

You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, converting warm, inbound leads into happy Unplugged Energy customers. This is not a lead generation role; you will be provided with qualified leads, allowing you to focus on what you do best: building rapport and closing sales. Full training on our products, systems, and the Australian solar and battery market will be provided.



What You'll Be Doing

You will be responsible for managing the entire sales process, including:

-Managing the sales@ email inbox and responding to all new customer enquiries promptly.

-Qualifying inbound leads to understand customer needs and project suitability.

-Engaging with potential customers via phone (RingCentral) and email. Strong and confident phone communication is essential for building rapport and closing deals.

-Educating clients on the financial and environmental benefits of our solar and battery solutions.

-Preparing customised, professional proposals using our Open Solar software.

-Diligently managing your sales pipeline and recording all customer interactions in our Zoho CRM system.

-Working to achieve and exceed sales targets.

-Building and maintaining long-term relationships with new and existing clients.



What We're Looking For (About You)

-A True Closer: You are a professional and dedicated individual with a tenacity for results. You aren't afraid to ask for the sale and have a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets without being pushy, confident yet consultative.

-Exceptional Communicator: You must have proficient English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a clear and easily understood speaking voice and you have experience selling to Australian or Western customers and can build trust and rapport quickly over the phone.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
EDUSFERE

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

K–12 Independent Schools  |  Work From Home (Philippines-Based)  |  Full-Time Hours | US School Hours



About the Role



Edusfere is a B2B SaaS edtech company that offers cutting-edge curriculum mapping software for K–12 schools. We are looking for a driven and articulate Sales Development Representative to work with our team as an independent contractor, engaged directly by Edusfere (no agency). In this role, you will be the first point of contact for independent K–12 schools primarily in the United States, plus selected international markets, generating qualified pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting and inbound lead management.



The ideal candidate brings B2B sales experience in SaaS or edtech, and direct experience in education, either as a former teacher, school administrator, or someone who has sold products and services into K–12 schools. You understand the language of educators, the rhythms of the school year, and how purchase decisions are made at independent schools. This domain expertise, paired with strong sales acumen and clear, confident English, will set you apart.



Key Responsibilities



* Outbound prospecting: Research target schools and contact school leaders (Heads of School, Principals, Directors of Learning) by phone,
, and LinkedIn, using lead lists and outreach campaigns we provide, to generate qualified demos.

Inbound lead management: Respond to and qualify inbound leads in a timely manner; assess fit, educate prospects on Edusfere’s value proposition, and book qualified demos with our sales lead.

* Book demos: Qualify interest and book qualified demos with our sales lead. After approval, run demos and sales conversations through to signed contracts.

* Callbacks and inquiries: Respond promptly to schools that call back or reply.

* CRM: Log every call, note, and outcome in HubSpot the same day.

* Feedback: Share what you hear from schools each week so we can improve our pitch and targeting.

* Market intelligence: Stay current on trends in independent school education, edtech adoption, and competitive landscape to refine messaging and targeting.



Required Qualifications



* 2+ years of experience in a sales, business development, or SDR role with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota.

* Native or near-native English proficiency with excellent written and verbal communication skills—you must be able to hold natural, confident conversations with US-based school leaders.

* Proficiency with CRM tools (HubSpot or similar).

* Available about 8 hours a day, Monday–Friday, on a schedule you set within US school hours (8:00 AM Eastern to 5:00 PM Pacific, roughly 9:00 PM–9:00 AM PHT).

* Work-from-home setup: reliable internet of at least 25 Mbps, backup internet (e.g. mobile data or pocket Wi-Fi) and backup power, a noise-cancelling headset, a webcam, a mobile phone, a quiet workspace, and a laptop or desktop in good working condition with a secure operating system and antivirus.

* Registered, or willing to register, with the BIR as self-employed.



Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience in the K–12 education sector: prior work as a classroom teacher, school administrator, admissions officer, or in an education-focused sales role.

* Experience selling into schools, school districts, or education institutions (independent, private, or international schools preferred).

* Familiarity with international school markets (Asia, Middle East, Latin America, Europe).

* Background in edtech, SaaS, or education services sales.

* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Communications, or a related field.



What Success Looks Like



* After ramp-up, consistently booking 15–20+ qualified demos per month with school decision-makers (Heads of School, Directors of Learning, Directors of Curriculum, or similar titles).

* Building a healthy pipeline of opportunities across US independent schools, plus selected international markets.

* Becoming a trusted first impression of Edusfere—school leaders feel they are speaking with someone who genuinely understands their world.

* Contributing insights from the front lines that improve Edusfere’s messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy.



Fees & Incentives



* Monthly fee: ₱45,000–65,000, depending on experience.

* Uncapped incentive pay: Under our current Sales Incentive Plan, a bonus for every qualified demo held, plus commission on deals that close.

* Training: Paid onboarding on our product, the US school market, and our sales process.

* Growth: A path to closing deals yourself at a higher commission rate, and into a senior sales role as Edusfere scales.

* Work from home: Fully remote; no commute.

* Collaborative, mission-driven team culture focused on transforming K–12 education.



How to Apply



If you are passionate about education and thrive in a fast-paced sales environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit:

* Your resume.

* A brief cover note explaining your B2B sales experience, any connection to education, and why this role interests you.

* A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself in English.

* A screenshot of a recent internet speed test.



Engagement type: This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. The selected candidate will provide services under an Independent Contractor Agreement with Edusfere, LLC, a US company, and will not be an employee of Edusfere or of any Philippine entity. You will set your own schedule within US school hours and decide how and where you perform the work. As an independent contractor, you will be responsible for your own taxes and BIR registration, government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), equipment, internet, and workspace. You will not be entitled to employee benefits such as leave, 13th-month pay, overtime, holiday pay, or night-shift differential. Fees are paid monthly in Philippine pesos against your invoice. You may provide services to other clients, provided there is no conflict of interest.



Edusfere welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and is committed to equal opportunity.

title: Appointment Setter for Australian Business (Australian or American Accent)
description:
About us

We're Knockd, an Australian software company. Knockd is an app for door-to-door sales teams. Reps log every door they knock on a shared live map, and managers see who's working, what's converting and which streets are done. We already have paying customers, including a fundraising agency that has logged over 20,000 knocks on the app.



The role

We're looking for an appointment setter to call owners and managers of Australian door-to-door businesses (solar, fundraising, telecom, pest control, security and more). You'll introduce Knockd, explain how it helps their team, and book them into a short online meeting with one of our founders.



Calls are short, usually 5 to 10 minutes. You're not closing deals or discussing pricing. Your job is to start a good conversation and get the meeting booked.



What you'll do

- Call business owners and managers from targeted lists we provide

- Give a quick overview of the app and how it helps their team

- Ask a few simple questions to check they're a good fit

- Book meetings directly into our founders' calendar

- Log every call and its outcome in our CRM

- Follow up with prospects who asked to be called back



What we provide

- Call lists, a dialer and CRM access

- Call scripts and frameworks, including answers to common objections

- Training on the app and direct support from the founders



Requirements

- An Australian or American accent, and excellent spoken English. You'll be speaking with Australian business owners all day.

- A confident, friendly phone manner, and comfort with cold calling

- A reliable internet connection, a quality headset and a quiet place to work

- Availability for Australian business hours, roughly 6:00am to 3:00pm Manila time, Monday to Friday



Preferred

- Previous cold calling, appointment setting or B2B sales experience

- Experience calling Australian, US or UK businesses

- Familiarity with CRMs or dialers (HubSpot, Apollo, JustCall, Aircall or similar)



Pay

Option 1: US$5/hour base, plus a US$25 bonus for every booked meeting that goes ahead.



Option 2 (for hungry salespeople): If you're confident in your ability to book meetings, we're happy to drop the hourly rate and pay a much more generous commission for every booked meeting that goes ahead. There's no cap. Your earnings depend purely on your results, so a strong setter can earn a lot more than the hourly option.



Part-time (to start), long-term role for the right person. We'll start with a paid one-week trial.
