title: Part-Time Xero Bookkeeper (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Weekly — one fixed day each week

● Reconcile the bank and credit card accounts in Xero, leaving nothing unreconciled

● Code every transaction to the correct account, the correct property (via tracking categories) and critically the correct VAT rate

● Reconcile booking platform payouts (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, direct/Stripe), recording gross booking income, platform commission and cleaning fees separately rather than posting only the net amount that lands in the bank

● Process supplier bills and receipts from our outsourced providers — cleaning, laundry, maintenance, management and software subscriptions

● Raise and send sales invoices for direct bookings, corporate or extended stays, and any re-charges

● Chase overdue invoices politely and keep the aged debtors list short

● Send a brief weekly update: what was done, what is outstanding, and any queries for us

Monthly

● Close the month by the [7th] working day

● Deliver the management pack: Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Aged Debtors, Aged Creditors and a simple cash summary

● Present the P&L per property as well as consolidated, so we can see which unit is performing

● Include a short written commentary — what moved, what looks unusual, what needs a decision from us. This matters to us as much as the numbers do.

● Reconcile control accounts: VAT, director’s loan, supplier balances and platform clearing accounts

● Confirm all recurring costs have landed — rent, business rates, energy, broadband, insurance and subscriptions

VAT and Making Tax Digital

This is a core part of the role, not an add-on.

● Prepare the quarterly VAT return for our review and submit it through Xero under MTD, comfortably ahead of the deadline (one calendar month and seven days after the quarter end)

● Apply the correct VAT treatment to income short-term holiday and serviced accommodation is standard-rated, unlike long-term residential letting

● Handle reverse charge VAT on commission and services invoiced from overseas platforms (for example Airbnb and Booking.com) correctly on the return

● Apply the correct input VAT rate to each cost — for example, business rates carry no VAT, domestic-rate energy may be reduced-rated, broadband and most services are standard-rated, and rent may be exempt unless the landlord has opted to tax

● Reconcile the VAT control account every month rather than only at quarter end, so surprises are caught early

● Maintain MTD-compliant digital records and digital links — no manual re-keying between systems

● Keep VAT evidence complete: a valid VAT invoice on file for every input VAT claim, chased from suppliers where missing

● Flag anything with an uncertain VAT treatment to us and our accountant rather than making an assumption

● Review, when asked, whether an alternative scheme ([standard / cash accounting / flat rate]) would suit the business better

Annual

● Prepare the year-end file and deal directly with our UK accountant’s queries

● Keep the chart of accounts, VAT rates and tracking categories tidy and consistent

Short-term rental specifics

● Reconcile each platform’s payout report to the bank — payouts arrive net of commission and often cover several bookings across a date split

● Keep the three properties cleanly separated so per-property profitability is always visible

● Split repairs and maintenance from capital improvements and furnishing costs correctly

● Track refundable damage deposits, guest refunds and chargebacks properly, including their VAT treatment

● Account for rent and other fixed property costs against the correct property and the correct period

Requirements

Essential

● Minimum 2–3 years’ hands-on bookkeeping in Xero — running the books day to day, not simply "familiar with" the software

● Demonstrable experience of bank reconciliation, raising and sending invoices, and producing monthly Profit & Loss statements

● Practical experience preparing and filing UK VAT returns under Making Tax Digital for a VAT-registered business

● Confident applying different VAT rates and knowing when VAT is not recoverable

● Experience working with UK-based clients and UK bookkeeping conventions

● Accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent practical experience

● Strong written and spoken English — you will
 suppliers and our accountant directly

● Confident in Excel or Google Sheets

● Reliable internet with a backup connection

● Genuine attention to detail — you notice when a figure looks wrong

Desirable

● Xero Advisor certification

● Experience with short-term rentals, serviced accommodation, Airbnb or hospitality clients

● Experience reconciling payment platform payouts (Airbnb, Booking.com, Stripe, PayPal)

● Familiarity with reverse charge VAT and cross-border service invoices

● Multi-property or multi-entity bookkeeping

We respect our employees' personal time and privacy. Our objective is to ensure that everyone is fully engaged, productive, and accountable during the hours they are being paid to work.

If you are looking for a remote position that you can work simultaneously with another job, this position will not be a good fit.

IMPORTANT — Our Approach to Airbnb Support & Guest Disputes:

The short-term rental industry has become increasingly competitive, and Airbnb's policies and support decisions are often unfavorable and unfair to hosts. Protecting our business requires us to be exceptionally strategic, resourceful, persistent, and willing to fight hard for our interests.

We are looking for someone who is tough, assertive, creative, and unafraid of confrontation or challenging authority. You must be comfortable pushing boundaries, questioning decisions, finding unconventional solutions, and using every available avenue to achieve favorable outcomes.

This is not a position for someone who automatically accepts "no" as an answer, blindly follows conventional approaches, or prioritizes pleasing people over protecting the business. We expect you to be a formidable advocate for PBnB, capable of navigating difficult disputes, challenging unfair decisions, and fighting relentlessly for every dollar legitimately owed to us.

We value results, strategic thinking, and the courage to challenge the status quo.

Schedule After Training (US Eastern Time):

Sunday: 10 AM–11 PM

Monday: 10 AM–11 PM

Tuesday: 4:30 PM–11 PM

Wednesday: 4:30 PM–11 PM

Thursday: 4:30 PM–11 PM

Friday: OFF

Saturday: OFF

Total: 42 working hours per week.

Breaks: 30 minutes for shifts of 8 hours or fewer; 60 minutes for shifts over 8 hours (to be taken in 15-minute intervals as able).

Vacation/PTO: 10 PAID Days Off Per Year.

13th-Month Bonus: For every full 12 months of employment completed with PBnB, you will receive an additional bonus equal to one month's regular base salary. This means that for every 12 months you work with us, you effectively earn the equivalent of 13 months of base salary. This bonus is earned only upon completing a full year of employment, beginning on your first employment anniversary and continuing on each subsequent anniversary. It is not paid early or prorated for incomplete years, except where required by applicable law. The advertised monthly salary already includes the annualized value of this bonus.

Training: Training will have flexible hours but typically between 10 AM–10 PM Eastern for 5 days a week and 30–40 hours a week. Training pay is $6 USD per hour. The training duration will depend on how quickly you learn and become fully ready to take on the job (with minimal help), but will be a minimum of 4 weeks and a maximum of 2 months.

Holidays/PTO: No US or Philippine holiday will automatically be a day off, and there is no additional holiday pay under this policy, except where required by applicable law.

Pay Schedule: Paydays are every 4 weeks on Tuesday nights. The pay period ends 2 weeks before payday. Payment takes 1–5 business days to transfer (2 seems most usual).

Company Overview:

Pinnacle Management LLC had humble beginnings, starting in 2018 when Founder Phil Bobbs started renting out the 2nd bedroom in his run-down house in downtown Raleigh occasionally on Airbnb. Eight years and hundreds of thousands of guests later, Pinnacle Management (affectionately called "PBnB" within the company) runs over 50 individual full-time short-term rentals in four cities on the East Coast, and continues to grow yearly.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Business Development & Property Acquisition

A major emphasis of this position is helping PBnB grow by identifying and pursuing profitable new properties and business opportunities.

You will:

Research and identify potential new rental properties in our existing markets and potentially new markets.

Search for houses and apartments suitable for rental arbitrage (renting properties long-term and operating them as short-term rentals).

Research potential property purchases and help identify opportunities to buy homes that would make profitable short-term rentals.

Find and contact landlords, property owners, investors, and other potential business partners.

Explain and present our rental arbitrage or property management proposals to prospective landlords and owners.

Research property rental rates, estimated Airbnb revenue, operating expenses, and potential profitability to help evaluate opportunities.

Follow up with prospective property owners and landlords, build relationships, and help move promising opportunities toward agreements.

Continually look for creative ways to expand PBnB's property portfolio and generate additional revenue.

You do not need to be an experienced real estate investor, but you must be commercially minded, persuasive, resourceful, and capable of researching opportunities and making intelligent business recommendations.

2. Revenue Management & Airbnb Listing Management

Another major focus of this position is maximizing revenue and profitability from our existing properties.

You will:

Regularly monitor the performance of our 50+ short-term rental properties, identifying properties that are not receiving as many bookings as expected.

Investigate possible reasons for poor booking performance, including pricing, competition, reviews, listing quality, photos, amenities, and other factors.

Use PriceLabs and other pricing tools to analyze and adjust nightly rates, discounts, minimum stays, and other pricing strategies.

Help maximize occupancy, nightly revenue, and overall profitability through thoughtful revenue management and yield management.

Monitor property review scores and identify when negative reviews or declining ratings may be affecting booking performance.

Regularly review and improve Airbnb listings, including titles, descriptions, photos, amenities, and other listing details.

Create and duplicate Airbnb listings and ensure that our active and backup listings are properly maintained.

Make sure properties have the necessary backup listings available and ready when needed.

Monitor Airbnb listings and accounts for warnings, flagged photos, restrictions, errors, and other problems that may affect visibility or bookings.

Investigate when a listing may need to be replaced or updated, including determining when a backup listing should be used, subject to Airbnb policies.

Monitor and manage Airbnb host accounts and identify problems requiring attention.

Continually research new strategies and opportunities to improve our listings, booking performance, and revenue.

You should be analytical, detail-oriented, commercially minded, and genuinely interested in discovering why a property is performing well or poorly and what can be done to improve it.

3. New Property Setups, Move-Ins & Move-Outs

You will help coordinate the complete process of launching new properties and closing properties when necessary.

Responsibilities include:

Planning and coordinating the setup of new short-term rental properties.

Arranging utilities, internet service, and other services required for new properties.

Researching, sourcing, and purchasing furniture, appliances, decorations, and household supplies within approved budgets.

Finding good deals on furniture and household items through
 Marketplace, Amazon, Walmart, and other retailers.

Communicating with sellers and coordinating furniture pickups and deliveries with local employees, movers, and delivery people.

Scheduling and coordinating movers, cleaners, maintenance workers, photographers, and other people involved in setting up new properties.

Working with local cleaners and setup personnel responsible for furnishing, decorating, organizing, and preparing new properties.

Ordering the supplies and furnishings needed to make properties fully ready for guests.

Coordinating photography, new Airbnb listings, and other preparations for launching a new property.

Keeping detailed checklists and schedules to ensure every part of a setup is completed correctly and on time.

Coordinating property move-outs and closures, including furniture removal, moving arrangements, canceling utilities, and other closing responsibilities.

You must be extremely organized, resourceful, cost-conscious, and capable of coordinating many moving parts without requiring constant management involvement.

4. Hiring, Recruiting & Employee Development

You will help ensure PBnB consistently hires and develops excellent employees and has sufficient staffing in every city.

Responsibilities include:

Creating and posting job advertisements for virtual assistants, cleaners, maintenance workers, and other positions.

Proactively searching for qualified candidates on hiring websites and other platforms.

Communicating with applicants, reviewing qualifications, and conducting initial interviews.

Helping evaluate candidates and making recommendations to management regarding hiring decisions.

Coordinating onboarding and training for new employees.

Helping create and improve employee training materials, tutorials, quizzes, assessments, and performance evaluations.

Identifying weaknesses in employee training and developing ways to improve employee knowledge and performance.

Ensuring we maintain a reliable pool of cleaners, maintenance workers, and backup service providers in each city.

Identifying employees with strong potential and helping them develop their abilities and advance within the company.

Continually improving our recruiting and training processes so we attract stronger employees and develop a more capable team.

We want someone with strong leadership instincts who can recognize talent, evaluate people intelligently, and help build a better-performing team.

5. Direct Supervision of Virtual Assistants

You will manage our guest messaging assistants during your shifts.

Responsibilities include:

Monitoring guest communications and daily operational tasks.

Auditing response times, work quality, and SOP compliance.

Identifying mistakes and performance deficiencies.

Coaching assistants and helping them improve.

Handling complicated issues escalated by assistants.

Evaluating performance and reporting results to management.

Maintaining a supportive but accountable team environment.

You must be comfortable making independent management decisions and holding other employees to high professional standards.

6. Complex Guest Issues and Dispute Resolution

You will personally manage difficult guest situations that require more than standard messaging templates.

This includes resolving complaints, evaluating refund requests, negotiating appropriate solutions, handling difficult customers, and making decisions that protect both the guest experience and the company's financial interests.

You must be diplomatic but firm, and comfortable saying no when requests are unreasonable.

7. Airbnb Support, AirCover, and Review Management

You will help manage:

Escalated Airbnb Support disputes.

Appeals of incorrect refunds and penalties.

AirCover damage and reimbursement claims.

Review disputes involving violations of Airbnb policies.

Accurate documentation, evidence gathering, and persistent follow-up.

We expect you to develop expert-level familiarity with Airbnb's written policies and use that knowledge to advocate effectively for the company.

8. Cleaner, Maintenance & Vendor Management

You will coordinate with cleaners, maintenance workers, and contractors across our markets.

This includes:

Reviewing reported maintenance issues and determining their urgency and priority.

Troubleshooting common property problems with guests, cleaners, and maintenance personnel.

Coordinating repairs and maintenance visits in a timely and cost-efficient manner.

Using Airtable to track maintenance issues and ensuring appropriate follow-up until completion.

Identifying when cleaners can investigate minor issues rather than unnecessarily dispatching maintenance workers.

Recognizing when specialized contractors or owner approval may be needed.

Ensuring cleaners and maintenance workers complete their assigned responsibilities correctly.

Coordinating staffing and scheduling to make efficient use of our local workers.

You must think strategically about staff utilization, vendor expenses, scheduling efficiency, accountability, and timely completion of work.

You will help ensure we always have reliable service-provider coverage.

Although the other PBnB Supervisor will have a greater focus on maintenance operations, you must also become knowledgeable and capable of managing maintenance issues independently during your shifts.

9. Business Process Improvement

We expect you to identify and solve operational problems proactively, rather than simply waiting for assignments.

You will help improve SOPs, training resources, templates, employee workflows, listing management procedures, revenue management processes, and other operational systems.

You should regularly develop practical proposals for increasing revenue, reducing expenses, improving service, strengthening employee performance, and preventing recurring problems.

We want someone who continually looks for better ways of doing things and takes the initiative to develop complete solutions rather than simply pointing out problems.

10. Other Operational and Management Responsibilities

You must also learn and be able to perform all standard virtual assistant responsibilities whenever coverage is needed.

These include guest messaging, booking management, cleaning schedules, supply orders, direct bookings, payment verification, Airbnb listing updates, reviews, and other property operations.

Additional responsibilities may include financial documentation, accounting, hiring, employee training, property maintenance coordination, and special management projects.

Minimum Qualifications

Excellent written and spoken English.

Previous management, supervisory, or operations experience.

Strong business sense and an interest in business development, revenue management, sales, real estate, or property management.

Excellent critical thinking and independent judgment.

Practical, resourceful, creative, and financially responsible decision-making.

Strong leadership and employee coaching abilities.

Exceptional reliability, integrity, and accountability.

Ability to manage multiple urgent issues while remaining organized.

Excellent computer skills and willingness to learn our software systems.

Strong analytical skills and an interest in understanding and improving business performance.

Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

Ability to take ownership of complex projects and independently coordinate them through completion.

Reliable computer with at least two monitors, fast internet, and dependable smartphone connectivity.

Interest in a long-term management career.

Previous experience in US property management, Airbnb operations, revenue management, dynamic pricing, real estate, business development, hospitality operations, or employee recruitment and management is particularly valuable.

Compensation and Advancement

In addition to the base salary, we intend to offer performance-based earning opportunities tied to objectively measurable results. There will be opportunities to earn up to an additional $800 monthly in bonuses tied to objective performance measures.

These may include improved assistant performance, operational improvements, guest review outcomes, AirCover recoveries, successful Airbnb appeals, improved property revenue, successful business development efforts, and other measurable contributions to PBnB's growth and profitability.

We're looking for someone ambitious who genuinely wants to help run, grow, and improve a business—not simply perform a collection of tasks.

title: Projects & Operations Lead (Remote, West Africa hours, possible quarterly travel to Nigeria)
description:
I run a portfolio of businesses and projects across manufacturing, consumer products, e-commerce and software, with most of the physical work in Lagos, Nigeria though I also have outsourced operations in the UK. I need a senior, hands-on Projects & Operations Lead to own delivery across that portfolio and keep me out of day-to-day execution. The role starts with a 3-month paid probation period. Confirmation into the permanent role depends on the 90-day outcomes below: owning 3 to 5 projects, milestones delivered on budget, and a measurable drop in my involvement in routine follow-up.



This is not a virtual assistant, project coordinator or research role. You will be accountable for outcomes: budgets, deadlines, suppliers and contractors. You will manage a Lagos-based Field Associate who is already in place and acts as your eyes and hands on the ground, and you will work with an AI agent setup that handles research, drafting, financial models and documentation. Your job is to direct both, verify what they produce, negotiate, chase, d
 and deliver.



READ THESE TWO POINTS FIRST

1. Hours: you work West Africa Time (UTC+1). That is roughly 4:00pm to 12:00am Manila time, Monday to Friday, with occasional calls outside that. Do not apply if this does not work for you long term.

2. Travel: you may be required to spend at least one week in Lagos every quarter, plus additional trips for critical project phases. Occasional travel to China for supplier visits, factory inspections and sourcing is also possible. You must be able and willing to obtain the necessary visas and travel. Flights and accommodation are covered.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own 3 to 5 active projects end to end, from brief to completed deliverable, within approved budgets.

- Select, negotiate with and manage suppliers, manufacturers, fabricators, developers and other contractors. Chase delivery until work is finished on the agreed date.

- Direct the Field Associate: set their visit schedule, specify exactly what evidence they bring back (photos, measurements, documents), and approve contractor payments only against that evidence.

- Brief the AI agents, review their output critically, and never act on an unverified number, price or supplier.

- Turn my voice notes and instructions into committed action plans with owners and dates.

- Raise risks early with a recommended course of action, not just a description of the problem.

- Within 90 days, take over maintenance of the AI workflows and reduce my involvement in routine follow-up to almost nothing.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- 3+ years delivering projects involving external contractors, suppliers or construction, ideally in an emerging market.

- Experience directing someone remotely who acted on your behalf (field team, site rep, sourcing agent) and being accountable for their work.

- Proof you have personally chased and closed out difficult deliveries: a late contractor, a failed shipment, a supplier dispute.

- Negotiation results you can quantify: savings, better terms, money recovered.

- Daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or similar) for real work, and the ability to explain a time the tool was wrong and how you caught it.

- Strong written and spoken English. Comfortable being direct with vendors and with me.

- Commercial judgement, discretion and integrity. You will handle money and confidential information without supervision.



NOT REQUIRED

- Advanced Excel or financial modelling. The agents build the models; you need to read one and spot a wrong assumption.

- Research or presentation skills. The agents do this.

- A specific degree. Track record matters more.



NICE TO HAVE

- Prior work with Nigeria or another African market.

- Manufacturing, sourcing or e-commerce background.

- Coordinating software developers as a non-developer.

- Working directly with a founder or owner-operator.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with:

1. Your CV or profile.

2. Two projects you personally delivered that involved external contractors or suppliers: your role, what went wrong, how you fixed it, and the measurable outcome.

3. One example of directing someone remotely who acted on your behalf, and how you knew their reports were accurate.

4. One example of an AI tool giving you a wrong answer in real work, how you caught it and what you did.

5. Confirmation you can work West Africa Time long term and travel to Nigeria and to China when required, and accept a 3-month probation period.

6. Your salary expectation in USD per month.



Applications that skip items 2 to 5 will not be read. Shortlisted candidates do a paid 48-hour practical assessment: an incomplete project brief, access to an AI assistant, and you are judged on what you verified, what you flagged as uncertain, and which decisions you would take to me versus make yourself. Polish is not scored.

title: Video Editor for Meta ads
description:
WHAT THIS IS

We're an Australian jewelry brand. We make personalized 18K gold plated jewelry — names, birthstones, initials — and we've served over 500,000 customers since 2022.

Almost all our growth comes from video ads on
 and Instagram, and we ship around 100 new creatives a week. We have more good footage and more good briefs than we have hands to cut them. That's the job.

This is a long-term, ongoing role. We are not looking for a project freelancer.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Cut finished 9:16 vertical ads from written briefs and raw creator footage, plus 4:5 and 1:1 versions

- Re-cut the opening 3 seconds of winning ads into 2–3 alternate hooks — a big part of the role

- Burned-in captions, properly timed — not raw auto-transcription

- Text overlays, price cards and call-to-action end frames

- Audio cleanup: levels, noise, ducking

- Colour matching across creators shot in different lighting

- Naming and delivering files to our convention

- 20–30 finished variants a week once you're up to speed



WHAT YOU NEED

- 2+ years on short-form vertical, including at least 1 year on direct-response ADS (Meta, TikTok, Shorts). Wedding films and long-form YouTube alone won't be enough here.

- Experienced in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut

- Fast and comfortable in CapCut. Most of our volume is quick variants, and that's where speed matters.

- Excellent written and spoken English

- A machine that handles a multi-layer 4K timeline: M1 Mac or better with 16GB+, or Windows with 16GB+ and a dedicated GPU. Plus 50 Mbps+ internet with a backup connection. Please don't apply if your setup is below this — it makes the turnaround times impossible and neither of us will enjoy it.



HOURS AND PAY

- 20–25 hrs/week, Monday to Friday. You pick your window as long as it overlaps at least 3 hours with Australian business hours — 9am to 2pm Philippine time works well.

- Rate is negotiable and based on experience — tell us your hourly rate in USD and we'll work from there. Paid twice monthly by Wise.

- Option to go full-time.



THE TRIAL EDIT

We're not going to hire off a résumé. We want to see you cut one ad.

Everything you need is in this folder:







Inside you'll find the creator clips and the product b-roll. That's all we're giving you — for the product, the brand and who we sell to, go to 
 and have a look around.

We have deliberately NOT included examples of our existing ads. We want to see how you'd approach this, not how well you can copy us.

MAKE US ONE AD:

- 9:16 vertical, exported as MP4

- Keep the jewelry clear and central — we need to see the necklace, and the initial on the heart should be legible

- Add background music

- There's no script and that's deliberate. The clips are all there — how you arrange them into an ad is the part we want to see. Order, structure, length, pacing, hook, on-screen text: all yours.

- Budget about 2 hours. We've pulled out the usable clips for you so you're not wading through a full footage dump. We know it's still real time and we don't ask for it lightly — but this is a long-term position and we want to get it right, so we'd rather see one ad you actually cut than read twenty résumés.



HOW TO APPLY

Four things. OnlineJobs.ph can't take file attachments, so everything below needs to be a link — Google Drive, Dropbox or an unlisted YouTube video. Paste them into your application message.

- Your trial edit — a Google Drive or unlisted YouTube link. Please check the sharing is set so we can actually open it.

- Your résumé and a link to your portfolio or reel.

- Your available hours per week and the daily window you'd work, in Philippine time.

- Your hourly rate in USD. Give a number — “negotiable” tells us nothing.

We really appreciate the time everyone puts into this. We'll do our best to get back to everyone who submits an edit.

title: Remote Executive Assistant
description:
We’re seeking a proactive, highly organized Virtual Executive Assistant to support a global top 100 Poker Player with a dynamic lifestyle and multiple businesses. This role spans financial admin, travel coordination, property management, personal projects, and more. Ideal for a resourceful, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented professional.



This is a remote, part-time position (20 hours/week for first 1-4 weeks during trial period with plans for full-time, benefits and bonuses). Requiring 1-2 hours overlap with Pacific Time when it’s needed to reach out to businesses that may only be open 8-5 PST for example. Typically we’d have 1 video meeting per week on Monday or Tuesdays to discuss the priorities and other work is flexible to be completed on your own time with due dates in mind.



Key Responsibilities

• Manage calendars, inboxes, scheduling, prioritization, and follow-through

• Coordinate travel including flights, hotels, transportation, and itineraries

• Track and organize expenses; Build and maintain spreadsheet-based reports

• Liaise with accountants for reporting, filings, or compliance support

• Conduct poker simulations to analyze game strategy and decision making

• Support property-related needs such as scheduling vendors, services, and invoices

• Conduct online research for vendors, pricing, products, and market data

• Order items and track deliveries/returns

• Coordinate gifts and services when needed

• Book personal appointments - health, wellness, dining, etc.

• Administrative tasks including streamlining personal and business systems

• Learn new tools independently and proactively research solutions without needing step-by-step instruction



Requirements

• Excellent spoken and written English with clear, professional communication.

• Prior experience with bookkeeping, financial admin, spreadsheets, or data reporting is strongly preferred

Prior experience with research, travel planning, or financial admin is strongly preferred.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, consistent, and dependable with reliable internet and computer access.

• Strong Google Workspace proficiency—especially Sheets (formulas, formatting, data cleanup; bonus if pivot tables are familiar).

• Resourceful problem solver—able to complete tasks independently, including entirely new tasks by researching how to do them

• Comfortable using AI tools especially Claude automations with the understanding that all outputs must be verified, fact-checked, and properly organized before delivery

• Enjoys learning new tools: Google Workspace, Asana, Claude, ChatGPT, Canva, financial and travel platforms.

• High integrity, ownership mindset, and commitment to delivering accurate, timely, polished work.

• Ability to work autonomously while being accessible for periodic check-ins (e.g., short AM/PM PST windows).



Benefits

• Part-time start with plans to grow into a long-term, full-time role within 1 month max

• Offer education and office reimbursements and other performance based bonuses for full time employees

• Flexible remote work with weekly check-ins to align the agenda for the week

• Opportunity to learn new systems, take on higher-level projects, and grow with the businesses

Please submit your application through the form below. Only candidates who complete the form will be considered. Resumes need to be up to date including months + year to show total duration in a role/company.



If the resume only has the years without any month, we will not move forward.

description:

Day Shift and hired as an employee with employee benefits (rather than as a freelance VA or independent contractor)

This role spans financial admin, travel coordination, property management, personal projects, and more. Ideal for a resourceful, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented professional.

• Excellent spoken and written English with clear, professional communication.

s to check mobile formatting

MANYCHAT AND AUTOMATIONS

Build Instagram DM automations in ManyChat, including keyword triggers, comment to DM flows, story reply flows, welcome messages and lead capture conversations

Write flows that collect name,
 and phone and push them into the client’s

Build out new keyword flows from a ManyChat tracker we give you, then duplicate and adjust flows for new promotions

Test every flow from a real Instagram account before marking it done

Keep a clean naming system inside each client’s ManyChat account so anyone on the team can find a flow

Report on what is working, including which keywords are getting used, so we can tell the client

SQUARESPACE WEBSITES

Fill in SEO fields on every page you touch, including page titles, descriptions, image alt text and URL slugs

s, landing pages, graphics and web sections that follow each client’s brand guidelines

s, promo posts and web pages when we do not have one ready

TIME TRACKING AND TASK MANAGEMENT

Full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday

Stable high speed internet, a reliable computer and a quiet workspace

title: Part-Time B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – US Businesses
description:
We are hiring an experienced, reliable B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for a financial automation platform serving live entertainment venues, theaters, sports organizations, and other ticketed businesses.



We need someone who is confident speaking with US business owners, finance directors, controllers, accounting managers, and other decision-makers.



This is a focused appointment-setting position with an established sales process.



We provide the leads, calling software, CRM, and sales guidelines. You focus on making calls, having quality conversations, qualifying prospects, and booking appointments.



No lead research, list building, or closing sales is required.



Responsibilities



- Make outbound calls to pre-researched, prioritized US business leads.

- Professionally navigate gatekeepers and reach the appropriate decision-makers.

- Ask discovery questions to identify potential business needs.

- Qualify interested prospects and schedule discovery appointments.

- Independently manage callbacks and follow-ups.

- Update HubSpot with accurate call outcomes, notes, and next steps.

- Provide a short daily report summarizing activity, conversations, and appointments.



Requirements



- At least 1 year of actual B2B outbound cold-calling experience.

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, professional phone presence.

- Experience calling US businesses and speaking with decision-makers.

- Strong listening, objection-handling, and appointment-setting skills.

- Comfortable following an established calling process.

- Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and quiet work environment.

- Consistent availability during US business hours.

- Dependable, organized, and able to work independently.



**Preferred experience:**

- B2B SaaS or software sales.

- Financial services, accounting, or professional services.

- Previous experience scheduling appointments with finance or operations executives.



Compensation and Growth

- Approximately 5 hours per week.

- Fully paid 2-week trial.

- Opportunity for ongoing work and increased hours based on performance.



We are not looking for someone who simply makes calls to hit a number.



We want someone who can have natural business conversations, identify genuine opportunities, and consistently book qualified appointments.



We value reliability, professionalism, accurate reporting, and follow-through.



How to Apply



Please submit the following (Replies without these answered will not be reviewed):



1. Experience: Briefly describe your B2B cold-calling experience, including the types of businesses and decision-makers you have contacted.



2. Results: Share an example of your previous appointment-setting results, including the number of calls and qualified meetings booked over a specific period.



3. Voice Recording: Include a 45–60 second recording introducing yourself and explaining your previous B2B cold-calling experience. A simple Vocaroo recording is fine.



4. Availability: Confirm that you can work approximately one hour per weekday during US business hours.



5. Scenario: How would you respond if a prospect said, "We're happy with our current software and don't need anything else"?



Please start your application with **"B2B Appointment Setter"** so we know you've read the posting.



We are looking to hire one dependable caller who can become a long-term part of our outreach team.

title: Construction Finishes & Fit-Out Superintendent
description:
Company: Rainbow Development Ltd.



Location: Cayman Islands



Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site



Job Summary



Rainbow Development is seeking an experienced, detail-obsessed Finishes & Fit-Out Superintendent to take our projects from structural completion (concrete superstructure, dried-in shell) to 100% turnkey handover.



You will bridge the gap between structural execution and high-end luxury completion. You won't just manage from a trailer—you will be on the floor verifying finish levels, auditing architectural drawings, coordinating interior layouts, sourcing bids, and driving subcontractors to a flawless finish. The ideal candidate has deep technical knowledge of high-end interior finishes, exterior cladding (EIFS), metal stud framing, drywall, and custom millwork integration.



Key Responsibilities



Trade Management & Coordination: Select, vet, get bids from, and manage subcontractors for all finish trades (drywall, metal studs, MEP rough-in/trim, flooring, custom cabinetry, painting, and EIFS).

Drawing & Layout Verification: Thoroughly review architectural and interior design drawings. Establish and verify finish floor levels (FFL), wall layouts, and ceiling heights to ensure seamless transitions.

Appliance & Millwork Integration: Coordinate rough-in requirements for high-end appliances, plumbing fixtures, and custom cabinetry, ensuring framing and utilities match shop drawings exactly.

Quality Control & The "Nitty-Gritty": Oversee the execution of exterior EIFS/stucco applications, drywall finishing (Level 4/5), tile layouts, and fine carpentry. Catch defects before they are covered up.

Scheduling & Procurement: Develop and maintain the finish-phase schedule. Track lead times for specialty finishes, fixtures, and materials to prevent site delays.



Punch List & Handover: Manage the final punch-list process with zero tolerance for subpar craftsmanship, delivering a flawless, 100% complete product to the client.





Qualifications & Skills



Experience: 5–7+ years of experience supervising high-end residential or boutique commercial interior fit-outs and finishes.

Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of metal stud framing, drywall assemblies, finish floor leveling, waterproofing, and exterior EIFS/stucco systems.

Blueprint Literacy: Advanced ability to read and interpret complex architectural, structural, MEP, and interior design/millwork shop drawings.



The "Eye": An uncompromising eye for detail, alignment, symmetry, and high-end craftsmanship.

Communication: Strong negotiation and communication skills to manage subcontractor bidding, coordinate schedules, and hold trades accountable to strict quality standards.



Tech Savvy: Comfortable using modern project management or plan-viewing software is a plus.





What We Offer



Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Opportunity to work on premier, high-visibility development projects.



A collaborative, structured team environment where structural execution matches finish quality.



Please reach out with your CV for further consideration.

description:
Role Overview

Return completed results within 24 hours of receiving each enquiry

Available Monday to Saturday

You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.





REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Coordinator (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Senior Digital Marketing Coordinator (Full-Time, Remote)

Global Hospitality FF&E Sourcing Company



We source furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) for hotels, resorts, multifamily developments, and hospitality projects worldwide. Our clients include hotel owners, developers, operators, designers, and procurement firms who rely on us to deliver exceptional sourcing solutions and project support.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and creative Senior Digital Marketing Coordinator to lead the execution of our digital marketing initiatives, strengthen our brand presence, and help generate business opportunities through strategic content creation, social media management, website optimization,
 marketing, and digital campaigns.



This is a full-time remote position for a self-driven marketing professional who can work independently, take ownership of projects, and consistently deliver high-quality results.



Key Responsibilities

Digital Marketing & Content Strategy

Develop and manage a comprehensive marketing calendar aligned with company goals.

Create and execute digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels.

Develop content strategies focused on hospitality, FF&E sourcing, procurement, interior design, and industry trends.

Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness, website traffic, and lead generation.

Social Media Management

Manage all company social media accounts, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, and other relevant platforms.

Create, schedule, publish, and optimize content.

Produce engaging graphics, videos, reels, project showcases, and educational content.

Monitor industry trends and proactively recommend new content ideas.

Build engagement with industry professionals, clients, manufacturers, designers, and hospitality decision-makers.

Content Creation

Write high-quality blog articles, case studies, project spotlights, newsletters, and marketing materials.

Transform project updates, supplier information, and company achievements into compelling marketing content.

Create and edit videos, graphics, presentations, and other digital assets.

Ensure all content is consistent with company branding and messaging.

Website Management & SEO

Maintain and update website content, project portfolios, service pages, and product information.

Optimize website content using SEO best practices.

Monitor website performance and recommend improvements.

Coordinate the development of landing pages and new website content.

AI-Powered Marketing

Utilize AI tools to improve content development, design, editing, research, and workflow efficiency.

Leverage platforms such as ChatGPT, Canva, Midjourney, Runway, CapCut, Adobe Express, and similar tools.

Stay current with emerging AI technologies and marketing trends.

 Marketing

Create and manage
 campaigns, newsletters, and promotional communications.

Maintain audience lists and support CRM marketing efforts.

Track and optimize campaign performance.

Analytics & Reporting

Track website, social media,
, and campaign performance metrics.

Prepare monthly marketing reports and performance summaries.

Use data and analytics to recommend improvements and increase marketing effectiveness.



Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional experience in digital marketing, content marketing, or marketing coordination.

Proven experience managing social media accounts and executing marketing campaigns.

Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong storytelling, copywriting, and content development abilities.

Advanced proficiency with Canva and other content creation tools.

Experience creating and editing video content for social media and digital marketing.

Hands-on experience using AI-powered content creation tools.

Experience working with WordPress or similar CMS platforms.

Solid understanding of SEO principles and best practices.

Experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, and marketing reporting.

Strong project management and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Reliable high-speed internet and dedicated home office environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in hospitality, hotels, interior design, furniture, architecture, construction, procurement, or related industries.

Experience working for a U.S.-based company.

Knowledge of B2B marketing and lead generation strategies.

Experience with HubSpot, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, or similar marketing platforms.

Familiarity with Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.

Experience developing case studies, sales materials, and client presentations.

Success Metrics



The successful candidate will be evaluated based on:



Growth in website traffic and SEO rankings.

Consistent content creation and publishing.

Social media audience and engagement growth.

Lead generation contribution.

 marketing performance.

Timely execution of marketing initiatives.

Brand consistency across all marketing channels.

Compensation & Benefits

$900 to $1,000 USD per month, based on experience and qualifications.

Full-time remote position.

Long-term career growth opportunity.

Work with a global hospitality sourcing company serving clients worldwide.

Direct collaboration with leadership.

Opportunity to shape and grow the company's marketing presence.



Work Schedule

Full-time position working during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Candidates must be available Monday through Friday during standard U.S. Eastern Time (EST/EDT) business hours, generally between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time. This role requires consistent availability for team collaboration, client communications, project coordination, and marketing execution.



This is a dedicated full-time position and is not intended for applicants seeking part-time or flexible scheduling arrangements.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume.

Portfolio of marketing work.

Examples of social media accounts you have managed.

Writing samples, blog articles, or published content.

Examples of graphics, videos, or campaigns you created.

A brief explanation of how you use AI tools in your marketing workflow.

Application Instruction



To confirm you have read the entire job posting, start your application with the word:

"Hospitality"



Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be considered.



Bonus Question



If hired, what would be your first 90-day marketing plan to increase brand awareness and generate qualified leads for a global hospitality FF&E sourcing company?



We are looking for strategic thinkers who can execute, measure results, and continuously improve our marketing efforts.

title: Telesales Representative (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for a confident, persuasive, and target-driven Telesales Associate who can turn prospects into qualified sales opportunities. This role requires more than making calls, you must capture attention, build trust quickly, identify buying signals, overcome initial objections, and successfully transfer interested prospects to a designated sales specialist.



The ideal candidate has strong spoken English, a sales-oriented mindset, and the ability to influence conversations naturally while maintaining professionalism. We are looking for individuals who are motivated by targets, coachable, resilient, and focused on generating quality leads that contribute directly to revenue.



Key Responsibilities

-Make high-volume inbound and outbound calls to prospective customers using company-provided systems and lead lists.

-Deliver a compelling opening that captures attention and establishes credibility within the first few seconds.

-Build rapport quickly and engage prospects in meaningful, sales-focused conversations.

-Ask strategic qualifying questions to identify customer needs, interest, buying intent, and readiness to purchase.

-Present the value of the product or service using approved sales scripts, key benefits, and accurate information.

-Handle initial objections confidently, maintain engagement, and create interest without being aggressive or misleading.

-Identify qualified prospects and execute smooth, consent-based live transfers to the designated sales specialist.

-Maximize successful transfers by ensuring prospects understand the purpose and value of speaking with the sales representative.

-Record call outcomes, qualification details, objections, and transfer results accurately in the designated system.

-Meet or exceed assigned KPIs for call volume, qualified leads, successful transfers, conversion quality, and attendance.

-Apply coaching and feedback to improve sales conversations, qualification rates, and overall performance.

-Follow approved scripts, customer communication standards, and applicable calling and consent requirements.



Qualifications

-Strong spoken English, clear pronunciation, confident delivery, and the ability to communicate persuasively.

-Previous experience in outbound sales, cold calling, telemarketing, lead generation, appointment setting, or call center sales is an advantage.

-Demonstrated ability to engage prospects, ask effective qualifying questions, handle objections, and influence customer decisions.

-Comfortable initiating conversations with strangers and handling rejection without losing confidence or momentum.

-Able to identify buying signals and distinguish genuinely interested prospects from unqualified leads.

-Sales-driven, competitive, self-motivated, and focused on achieving measurable results.

-Coachable and willing to apply feedback, follow structured sales processes, and improve through call reviews.

-Strong listening skills, attention to detail, and accurate documentation habits.

-Reliable attendance, accountability, and the ability to perform consistently throughout the shift.



Work Requirements

-Comfortable making consistent, high-volume outbound calls throughout the shift.

-Willing to work toward daily and weekly performance targets and be evaluated based on measurable KPIs.

-Able to follow a structured sales and qualification process while keeping conversations natural and engaging.

-Must maintain a stable internet connection, reliable computer, and good-quality headset.

-Must be available for the required work schedule, including applicable night shifts, weekends, and other agreed working hours.

-Must be open to regular coaching, call monitoring, and performance reviews.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role is measured by your ability to generate qualified opportunities, secure successful live transfers, maintain high call quality, and consistently meet performance targets. We value agents who combine strong communication skills with commercial awareness, resilience, and a genuine drive to produce results.

title: AirBnB  Supervisor — Maintenance & Property Operations
description:
IMPORTANT — About This Position:



THIS IS NOT A VIRTUAL ASSISTANT POSITION. We are hiring a genuine operations manager who happens to work remotely.



We are looking for an exceptionally intelligent, resourceful, practical, and ambitious person who thinks independently, exercises excellent judgment, and approaches problems as if they were running their own business.



This position will have significant responsibility for supervising our virtual assistants, handling complicated guest issues, and overseeing maintenance operations across our properties.



A particularly important focus will be residential property maintenance and cost-efficient coordination of cleaners, maintenance workers, and contractors.



We want someone who doesn't simply follow instructions or complete tasks, but understands the bigger picture, solves problems creatively, anticipates future problems, and continually improves how our business operates.



You will directly supervise our Filipino virtual assistants and local US cleaners and maintenance workers during your shifts and report to PBnB ownership/management.



IMPORTANT — Full-Time Commitment & Accountability:



This position requires your full professional attention and commitment during all scheduled working hours. Working for another employer, serving other clients, or performing freelance work simultaneously during PBnB shifts is strictly prohibited.

We are looking for someone who considers PBnB their primary professional commitment. Any other ongoing employment or freelance commitments must be disclosed before hiring and approved by management. Outside commitments must never interfere with your availability, performance, or responsibilities at PBnB.

We take accountability seriously. Employee performance is evaluated through work-quality audits, response-time tracking, task completion records, and other objective performance measures. PBnB may also implement work-activity monitoring software, potentially including time and activity tracking and periodic work-related screenshots during scheduled shifts, with appropriate notice and privacy safeguards.

We respect our employees' personal time and privacy. Our objective is to ensure that everyone is fully engaged, productive, and accountable during the hours they are being paid to work.

If you are looking for a remote position that you can work simultaneously with another job, this position will not be a good fit.



IMPORTANT — Our Approach to Airbnb Support & Guest Disputes:

The short-term rental industry has become increasingly competitive, and Airbnb's policies and support decisions are are often unfavorable an unfair to hosts. Protecting our business requires us to be exceptionally strategic, resourceful, persistent, and willing to fight hard for our interests.

We are looking for someone who is tough, assertive, creative, and unafraid of confrontation or challenging authority. You must be comfortable pushing boundaries, questioning decisions, finding unconventional solutions, and using every available avenue to achieve favorable outcomes.

This is not a position for someone who accepts "no" as an answer, blindly follows conventional approaches, or prioritizes pleasing people over protecting the business. We expect you to be a formidable advocate for PBnB, capable of navigating difficult disputes, challenging unfair decisions, and fighting relentlessly for every dollar owed to us.

We value results, strategic thinking, and the courage to challenge the status quo.



Schedule After Training (US Eastern Time):



Sunday: OFF



Monday: OFF



Tuesday: 10 AM–5 PM



Wednesday: 10 AM–5 PM



Thursday: 10 AM–5 PM 



Friday: 10 AM–11 PM



Saturday: 11 AM–11 PM



Breaks: 30 mins for shifts of hrs or less; 60 minutes for shifts over 8 hours (to be taken in 15 min intervals as able)



Vacation/PTO: 10 PAID Days Off Per Year

13th-Month Bonus: For every full 12 months of employment completed with PBnB, you will receive an additional bonus equal to one month's regular base salary. This means that for every 12 months you work with us, you effectively earn the equivalent of 13 months of base salary. This bonus is earned only upon completing a full year of employment, beginning on your first employment anniversary and continuing on each subsequent anniversary. It is not paid early or prorated for incomplete years. The advertised monthly salary already includes the annualized value of this bonus.

Training: Training will flexible hours but typically between 10am-10pm EST for 5 days a week and 30-40 hours a week. Training pay is $6 USD per hour. The training duration will depend on how quickly you learn and become fully ready to take on the job (with minimal help), but will be a minimum of 4 weeks and a maximum of 2 months.



Holidays/PTO : No US or PH holiday will be off automatically and there is no additional holiday pay.

Pay Schedule: Paydays are every 4 weeks on Tuesday nights. The pay period ends 2 weeks before payday. Payment takes 1-5 business days to transfer (2 seems most usual).



Company Overview:



Pinnacle Management LLC had humble beginnings, starting in 2018 when Founder Phil Bobbs started renting out the 2nd bedroom in his run-down house in downtown Raleigh occasionally on AirBnB. Eight years and hundreds of thousands of guests later, Pinnacle Management (affectionately called “PBnB” within the company) runs over 50 individual full-time short-term rentals in four cities on the East Coast, and continues to grow yearly.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Maintenance Management and Troubleshooting



A major emphasis of this position is coordinating maintenance for our properties efficiently and economically.



You will:

- Review and prioritize reported maintenance problems.

- Determine which issues are urgent and which can reasonably wait.

- Troubleshoot problems with guests, cleaners, and maintenance technicians.

- Understand common residential plumbing, HVAC, electrical, appliance, and general maintenance issues.

- Identify when cleaners can investigate minor issues instead of unnecessarily dispatching maintenance workers.

- Coordinate repairs across multiple properties and cities.

- Combine maintenance tasks when possible to reduce unnecessary trips and expenses.

- Recognize when licensed specialists or owner approval are needed.

- Manage maintenance tasks in Airtable, ensuring every issue receives appropriate follow-up through completion.

- Identify recurring maintenance problems and develop permanent solutions.

You do not need to be a professional tradesperson, but you must be practically knowledgeable, highly resourceful, and capable of communicating intelligently with technicians and contractors.



2. Direct Supervision of Virtual Assistants



You will manage our guest messaging assistants during your shifts.



Responsibilities include:

- Monitoring guest communications and daily operational tasks.

- Auditing response times, work quality, and SOP compliance.

- Identifying mistakes and performance deficiencies.

- Coaching assistants and helping them improve.

- Handling complicated issues escalated by assistants.

- Evaluating performance and reporting results to management.

- Maintaining a supportive but accountable team environment.

You must be comfortable making independent management decisions and holding other employees to high professional standards.



3. Complex Guest Issues and Dispute Resolution



You will personally manage difficult guest situations that require more than standard messaging templates.



This includes resolving complaints, evaluating refund requests, negotiating appropriate solutions, handling difficult customers, and making decisions that protect both the guest experience and the company's financial interests.



You must be diplomatic but firm, and comfortable saying no when requests are unreasonable.



4. Airbnb Support, AirCover, and Review Management



You will help manage:

- Escalated Airbnb Support disputes.

- Appeals of incorrect refunds and penalties.

- AirCover damage and reimbursement claims.

- Review disputes involving violations of Airbnb policies.

- Accurate documentation, evidence gathering, and persistent follow-up.

We expect you to develop expert-level familiarity with Airbnb's written policies and use that knowledge to advocate effectively for the company.



5. Cleaner and Vendor Management



You will coordinate with cleaners, maintenance workers, and contractors across our markets.



You must think strategically about staff utilization, vendor expenses, scheduling efficiency, accountability, and timely completion of work.



You will help ensure we always have reliable service-provider coverage.



6. Business Process Improvement



We expect you to identify and solve operational problems proactively, rather than simply waiting for assignments.



You will help improve SOPs, training resources, templates, maintenance procedures, employee workflows, and other operational systems.



You should regularly develop practical proposals for reducing expenses, improving service, and preventing recurring problems.



7. Other Operational and Management Responsibilities



You must also learn and be able to perform all standard virtual assistant responsibilities whenever coverage is needed.



These include guest messaging, booking management, cleaning schedules, supply orders, direct bookings, payment verification, Airbnb listing updates, reviews, and other property operations.



Additional responsibilities may include hiring and training, property setup and move-outs, administrative work, and financial documentation.



Minimum Qualifications

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Previous management, supervisory, or operations experience.

- Strong understanding of residential property maintenance, troubleshooting, or property management.

- Excellent critical thinking and independent judgment.

- Practical, resourceful, and financially responsible decision-making.

- Strong leadership and employee coaching abilities.

- Exceptional reliability, integrity, and accountability.

- Ability to manage multiple urgent issues while remaining organized.

- Excellent computer skills and willingness to learn our software systems.

- Reliable computer with at least two monitors, fast internet, and dependable smartphone connectivity.

- Interest in a long-term management career.

Previous experience in US property management, Airbnb operations, residential maintenance coordination, facilities management, or hospitality operations is particularly valuable.



Compensation and Advancement



In addition to the base salary, we intend to offer performance-based earning opportunities tied to objectively measurable results. There will be opportunity to earn up to additional $800 monthly in bonuses tied to objective performance measures.



These may include improved assistant performance, operational improvements, guest review outcomes, AirCover recoveries, and successful Airbnb appeals.



We're looking for someone ambitious who genuinely wants to help run and improve a growing business—not simply perform a collection of tasks.

title: SEO Expert
description:
THIS IS A FULL TIME ROLE.



We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them. 



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

• Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

• Crawlability and indexation

• Site architecture and internal linking

• Canonicalization and rendering issues

• Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

• Work directly within:

• WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

• Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

• PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

• Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

• Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

• Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

title: Affiliate Content Manager
description:
[IMPORTANT] To apply, please fill in the application form here: 



About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in the USA and Singapore. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth. We currently have over 5 remote Filipino team members and are proud to be a remote-first company.



The Role



We're looking for an Affiliate Content Manager to grow and run our network of affiliate creators: finding the right creators, getting them excited about Crafti, and making sure the content they post actually makes people buy.



This is an analytical role, not a creative one. You don't need years of experience. What matters is that you enjoy pulling videos apart to understand why some sell and others don't, and that you keep using what you learn to make the next round better.



You'll thrive here if you:



- Watch a TikTok or Reel and naturally break down why it worked or didn't: the hook, the first 3 seconds, the format, the comments

- Care more about whether a video sold the product than whether it looked nice

- Enjoy comparing results, spotting patterns and testing small changes to see what improves

- Can juggle dozens of creator conversations across DMs,
 and WhatsApp without letting anyone slip through the cracks

- Follow up and push things forward rather than wait to be told what's next

- Learn fast and pick up new tools (including AI) on your own



Do not apply if:



- You mainly see yourself as a creative and want to make your own content. This role is about analysing and improving content, not creating it.

- You don't use TikTok or Instagram regularly yourself

- You are uncomfortable being a project manager or following up with people who go quiet

- Your written English is not clear and professional. You will be writing to creators on our behalf.



What You'll Do



- Creator Sourcing: find and reach out to creators whose audience matches ours (women aged 25–35 who are into wellness, pilates and healthy routines)

- Affiliate Management: onboard creators, send free product, agree on terms and keep every creator moving from "interested" to "posted"

- Content Briefing: write clear briefs based on what has actually worked for us and what is trending right now

- Content Review: review creator content before it goes live and give specific feedback to improve it

- Performance Analysis: track how every post performs (views, clicks, sales), work out what the winners have in common, and feed that back into the next briefs

- Trend Watching: spot formats and trends we should test, and back up your suggestions with examples of how they are performing



What We Are Looking For



Skills:



- Strong understanding of short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and what makes people buy

- Organised: comfortable keeping trackers in Google Sheets or similar

- Clear, friendly written English

- Comfortable with tech tools and AI

- Bonus (not required): experience with influencer outreach, product gifting



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- Urgency and ownership: today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done

- Proactive communicator: if something might go wrong, I flag it early

- Has opinions: I want to suggest a better way, and I back it up with evidence





Details



This is a remote contract role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 75,000 per month



Commitment: Contract role with the option to extend if found to be suitable

Hours: Philippine business hours, Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm, with flexibility to reply to creators outside these hours

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Japanese Product Reels/TikTok) – $6 per Set (1 Main + 2 Hook Variations) Romaji Script Provided
description:
We produce short vertical product videos (15–60 seconds) in Japanese for Instagram Reels and TikTok for an Amazon affiliate business. We are looking for reliable editors for ongoing, template-based work.



IMPORTANT: RED/Xiaohongshu (小红书) is REQUIRED

This role includes BOTH footage research and video editing. You must have a working RED account and be able to search it from your location. Search RED first and prioritize footage found on RED. TikTok may be used only as a fallback when the required footage cannot be found on RED. TikTok-only sourcing is not allowed. Applicants who can only use TikTok cannot perform this role.



Japanese is NOT required. We give you a romaji (Japanese written in English letters) version of every script, so you can check the AI voiceover by listening and comparing it with the romaji script. Our Japanese team handles any remaining quality issues.



What we provide for each set

• A Japanese script (for captions) and a romaji script (for the reading check).

• Reference videos and sourcing instructions. You will research matching footage on RED first, with TikTok used only as a fallback. Use only footage approved for the project.

• A project template (Premiere Pro or CapCut), the designated fonts, and a caption style guide.



Your tasks for each set

• Research matching footage, searching RED first and using TikTok only if the footage cannot be found on RED. Record the source URLs in our spreadsheet.

• Put the Japanese script into captions (copy and paste; do not rewrite the text).

• Generate the Japanese AI voiceover with our designated tool and settings.

• Listen to every line and compare it with the romaji script to check for misreadings. Fix misreadings before editing, and tell us about anything unclear.

• Edit the short video with the approved footage, following the template and the designated fonts.

• Make 2 hook variations (see below).



Hook variations (3 videos per set)

• Each set = 1 main video + 2 hook variations.

• In each hook variation, change ONLY the order of the supplied clips in the first ~3 seconds. Do not write new text and do not add new footage.

• Everything after the first ~3 seconds must be identical to the main video.

• File names: 01_main.mp4, 01_hookA.mp4, 01_hookB.mp4 (the number is the set number).



Software: Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut (your own licensed software).

Estimated time: about 20–30 minutes per main video once you are used to the template (our estimate). Hook variations are shot-order changes only.



Payment

• Fixed price: $6 per set (1 main video + 2 hook variations), including AI voiceover generation and the misreading check.

• Paid test: $6 for one set. We will test 3 editors with the same task.
