title: Social Media
description:
Social Media Coordinator ~ Mindful & Co Kids



The role in one line



We’re looking for a Social Media Coordinator to own organic social for a children’s mindfulness brand selling direct to parents in Australia and the USA, and wholesale into retailers - and to grow a real community around it, not just a posting schedule.



About us



Mindful & Co Kids makes mindfulness tools for children - weighted buddies, yoga cards, board games, worry stones, calming oils, printable kits. We’re founded and led by a child psychotherapist, we sell through our own stores in Australia and the USA, and we’re stocked by retailers in both markets.



We’re a small team and everyone’s work is visible. Nothing disappears into a department.



What you’d own



Instagram - the main channel. Feed, Reels, Stories, DMs, community.

Pinterest - a real growth channel for us that hasn’t been worked properly.

 - currently organic-dead. You’d help us d
 whether to revive it or formally park it.

TikTok - our US account.

Content production - designing in Canva, editing Reels in CapCut, writing captions that sound like us.

Creator and affiliate relationships - we run a creator gifting program and an affiliate program through Trybe.

ManyChat - our keyword automations and DM flows.

Reporting - what worked, what didn’t, what you’d change. Monthly.



What we actually need you to be good at



Non-negotiable, and we will ask for proof:



eCommerce experience. You’ve run social for a product brand that sells online. You understand that content has a job and the job is revenue.

Wholesale or retail experience, or a genuine willingness to learn it - our wholesale and DTC audiences are different and we post for both.

Organic growth you can evidence. Show us an account you grew. Real numbers, real dates, and what you did that caused it. Follower counts alone don’t tell us anything.

Expert Canva. Not “I can use Canva.” You’ll be building full monthly content packs, campaign assets and templates.

CapCut. Reels that hold attention, not slideshows.



Strongly preferred: ManyChat, affiliate or creator program management (we use Trybe), Pinterest growth, and experience with a kids, wellness, education or parenting brand.



How we work, and who this suits



We’re being direct about this because it matters more to us than any single skill.



Reliability is the job. If you say it’ll be done Thursday, it’s done Thursday. If it won’t be, we hear that on Tuesday, not Friday.

We track hours with Hubstaff. That’s how we invoice and plan. We expect what’s logged to be what was worked, on a computer, on our projects.

Meetings start on time and we’re on camera. We’re a small team across time zones and the calls are short - showing up properly is most of it.

Everything is built in our accounts. Our Canva, our Dropbox, our logins. Work made for Mindful & Co Kids belongs to Mindful & Co Kids and lives somewhere the team can reach it.

We want your ideas. The last thing we need is someone waiting for a brief. We want someone who comes to the Monday call with “I think we should try this, here’s why.”

We want someone building a career, not filling a gap. If this is a placeholder while you look for something else, it won’t work for either of us.



What we offer



20–25 hours a week to start, with real scope to grow the role and the hours if the work is strong.

A small, genuinely kind team. No politics, no layers.

Ownership. This is the whole organic channel, yours to run.

Growth. As the brand grows, this role grows with it - into broader marketing, paid, or team leadership, depending on where you’re strong.

Work that means something. We make things that help children manage big feelings. Parents write to us about it.

Remote, with overlap into Australian business hours. 



How to apply



Please send:



Your portfolio - the social work, not a general design folder.

One account you grew. Tell us the starting point, the end point, the timeframe, and specifically what you did. We’d rather see one honest case study than five logos.

Three examples of Reels you edited yourself.

A short note - 150 words is plenty - on one thing you’d change 
 in your first month, and why.



Point 4 is the one we read first.



Please
 your resume to 
 (I will only consider applicants through
)



Shortlist stage



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid task: design one carousel and one Reel concept to a brief, in Canva and CapCut. We pay for your time on it.

title: Engineering Team Coordinator (Delivery & Execution)
description:
We are seeking an Engineering team coordinator who can own predictable delivery across engineering by enforcing sprint discipline, decision clarity, and execution standards. Reduce coordination cost, eliminate rework, and ensure that engineering output is reviewable, shippable, and on time.



Core Responsibilities



Sprint Ownership & Delivery Control

• Own sprint planning, execution, and closure

• Enforce sprint scope boundaries (no silent mid-sprint additions)

• Ensure all tickets entering a sprint meet Definition of Ready

• Track and act on: ticket aging, spillover, churn, blocked work

• Move tickets aggressively across states (TODO ? IN PROGRESS ? REVIEW ? DONE)

• Kill zombie tickets



Timebox Enforcement

• Treat timeboxes as coordination contracts, not estimates

• Require proactive communication before a timebox slips

• Block review if timebox standards are violated

• Escalate early, not after the fact



Execution Quality Gates

• Enforce: Definition of Ready (before sprint), Definition of Done (before release)

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure code review happens before QA

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Enforce agreed standards consistently: no duplication without approval, no implicit architecture decisions, no skipping ticket states

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

• Track repeat violations and escalate



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong judgment around delivery tradeoffs

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

• Ability to stop work and force alignment

• Low tolerance for ambiguity in execution

• Bias for early escalation over late heroics

• Calm under pressure, emotionally neutral

• Experience running sprints that actually ship

• Strong English language skills

• Familiarity with Jira-style workflows



Nice to Have

• Background as senior engineer

• Experience in SaaS / platform teams

• Worked alongside TPMs or Product Managers

title: Senior Fulfilment and Last Mile Operations Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time



Make the daily decisions that keep deliveries moving, warehouse capacity under control and transport costs balanced.



We are looking for an experienced fulfilment and last mile operations professional to take ownership of the flow of customer orders from our warehouses through to final delivery.



This is a senior, hands-on role with a strong focus on operational judgement. You’ll work closely with the Fulfillment team lead, our warehouse, customer service and transport partners to make practical decisions that balance customer commitments, available space, delivery capacity and cost.



You’ll need to see the whole picture. Sometimes bringing stock forward protects a customer delivery date. Other times, consolidating a linehaul movement makes better commercial sense, or moving stock sooner is necessary to free up warehouse space and keep orders flowing. Your role is to weigh the trade-offs, make the call and ensure the teams involved follow through.



What you’ll be responsible for:



Daily fulfilment decisions: Set priorities across picking, dispatch, stock transfers and delivery, taking account of order readiness, capacity and customer commitments.



Warehouse capacity and stock flow: Work with warehouse leaders to manage space constraints, inbound arrivals and outbound volumes, preventing congestion and unnecessary handling.



Linehaul planning: Balance transfer timing, load utilization and transport costs against stock availability and warehouse capacity.



Last mile delivery: Manage courier and delivery partner performance, bookings, service standards and delivery exceptions.



Customer outcomes: Work with customer service to identify delivery risks early, agree realistic solutions and ensure customers receive clear updates.



Exception management: Resolve competing priorities, delayed movements, failed deliveries and urgent orders, understanding the wider impact of each decision.



Commercial performance: Monitor cost per delivery, linehaul utilisation, redelivery costs and other controllable expenses, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.



Team coordination: Give clear direction, establish ownership and hold internal teams and external partners accountable for agreed actions.



Back office Admin: Leading our back office admin team who liaises with locally based suppliers, will also form part of this positions' remit.



Continuous improvement: Strengthen processes, reporting and systems so the operation becomes more reliable and easier to manage.



You’ll also step into the operation when needed—investigating an issue on the warehouse floor, checking an order or helping the team through a peak period.



What you’ll bring

Strong experience in fulfilment, transport or last mile operations, ideally within furniture, bulky goods, retail or a similar delivery environment.



Experience coordinating warehouses, interstate linehaul movements and external delivery partners.



The ability to make sound decisions when priorities compete and information is incomplete.



Commercial awareness: you understand how delivery promises, stock movements, storage constraints and transport choices affect cost and service.



Confidence using operational data and warehouse, ERP and delivery systems to identify issues and guide decisions.



Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with warehouse teams, customer service, suppliers and senior management.



A practical approach, strong follow-through and a willingness to get involved when needed.



What success looks like



Customer orders move predictably from warehouse to delivery. Stock transfers are planned with both capacity and cost in mind. Delivery risks are identified early, avoidable costs are reduced, and everyone involved understands the priorities and their responsibilities.

title: AI Automation & Integration Engineer
description:
AI Automation & Integration Engineer



Love Building Things with AI? We Want to Meet You!



Are you the kind of person who discovers a new AI tool and immediately starts experimenting with what it can do?



Do you enjoy taking an idea, figuring out how to make it work, and building something that actually makes people's lives easier?



If so, this could be a really exciting opportunity!



We're looking for a curious, creative, and hands-on AI Automation & Integration Engineer to help an established U.S. advertising agency transform the way its teams work through artificial intelligence.



You'll work directly with agency leadership, explore emerging technologies, and turn ideas into practical AI-powered solutions. You'll have room to experiment, take ownership of your projects, and make a real impact.



This isn't just about using AI. It's about building with it!



What You'll Be Doing:

- Build AI-powered tools, automations, and integrations that make everyday work easier and more efficient.

- Turn ideas and business challenges into working solutions, from concept through implementation.

- Connect software platforms using APIs, AI coding tools, and automation technologies.

- Experiment with tools like Claude, Claude Code, OpenAI, Gemini, and other emerging AI platforms.

- Collaborate with paid media, creative, analytics, finance, and operations teams to identify opportunities to streamline workflows, automate repetitive processes, improve data accessibility, and drive operational efficiencies through AI. 

- Research new AI technologies and recommend creative ways to put them to work.

- Partner with leaders to identify training needs, then build documentation and training materials that help employees use your solutions and apply AI in their daily work. 

- Test, troubleshoot, and improve tools to keep everything running smoothly and securely.



What We're Looking For:

- Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, automations, or software integrations.

- Experience with AI development or coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI, or comparable platforms.

- Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, scripting, or development workflows.

- A practical understanding of data privacy, security, and responsible AI implementation.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take an idea and turn it into a working solution.

- A self-motivated, proactive personality. You enjoy figuring things out and don't need someone directing every step.

- Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate confidently with U.S.-based colleagues.

- Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects independently.

- A genuine passion for AI, emerging technologies, and continuous learning.



You don't need to know every AI platform or have a specific job title in your background. What matters most is what you've actually built, your technical foundation, and your enthusiasm for solving problems.



Some of the Tools You'll Work With:

Claude, Claude Code, OpenAI, Gemini, Snowflake, Google Workspace, Slack, Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and other technologies as they emerge.



Don't worry if you haven't used all of them. We're looking for someone who's excited to learn and explore!



Why This Is an Exciting Opportunity:

- Make a real impact: Build tools that people will actually use to improve their daily work.

- Work directly with leadership: Your ideas and recommendations will be heard and valued.

- Explore cutting-edge AI: Experiment with new technologies and help determine which tools are worth adopting.

- Own your projects: Enjoy the freedom to solve problems, try new approaches, and bring ideas to life.

- Keep growing: Work with a team that is genuinely excited about AI and committed to finding new ways to use it.

- Build for the long term: Join an established U.S. agency that's making AI an important part of its future.



Position Details:

- Monthly Salary: $2,600 USD

- Employment: Full-time, long-term

- Location: 100% remote 

- Schedule: 8:30am - 5:30pm, U.S. Pacific Time business hours 

- Collaboration: Work closely with a U.S.-based agency leadership and internal teams



How to Apply:

We'd love to learn more about you and see what you've been creating!



Follow this link: 



Please submit your resume along with a short video/voice recording answering these questions:

1. What's an AI-powered tool, automation, or integration you've personally built? Tell us what it does, which technologies you used, and what your role was in creating it.

2. Tell us about a time you had to figure out a technical challenge on your own. How did you approach it, and what was the outcome?

3. What AI development or coding tools are you currently using, and what's something interesting you've recently built or experimented with?



If you have a portfolio, GitHub repository, or project demo, we'd love to see it too!



If you're excited about AI, love bringing ideas to life, and want your work to make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels / TikToks) — Content Agency
description:
About us:

We’re a content agency that produces short-form video for business owners — scroll-stopping Reels and TikToks that get our clients real results, not just views. We shoot the raw footage; you turn it into finished, ready-to-post content. This is a long-term role with real room to grow.





What you’ll be doing:



Editing vertical short-form videos (15–60 sec) from our raw footage — Reels, TikToks, Shorts



Creating on-screen visuals and animations that illustrate what the speaker is saying — when a client explains a point, you bring it to life with graphics, text, and visual elements



Clean animated captions, music, sound effects, color, and our branding



Sourcing your own B-roll and stock footage — pulling visuals from the client’s website, Google, and stock libraries to make the edit stronger. You don’t wait for footage; you find what the video needs



Cutting for retention — a strong hook in the first 2 seconds, tight pacing, and a CTA on every video



Occasional long-form editing (rare, but it comes up)



Following a simple brief for each client (we give you the hook, the vibe, the CTA)



Delivering batches consistently and on time









What I’m looking for (read carefully):



Consistency — the same high quality on video #1 and video #30. This matters most.



Communication — you reply, you ask when something’s unclear, you keep me updated. I will not chase you.



Availability — you must be able to work US Eastern Time daytime hours (roughly 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET). This is non-negotiable; I need you working during my business day, not on a delay.



Strong English — you clearly understand direction and communicate back without confusion.



Strong visual animation + text skills — this is core, not a bonus. You can build on-screen graphics that explain a point, not just slap on captions.



Resourcefulness — you can find B-roll and stock footage on your own to elevate a video.



Software — you must edit in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a big plus). CapCut will not be considered — if it’s your main tool, this role isn’t the fit.



A real eye for what’s working on IG/TikTok right now — pacing, transitions, text styling



Handles volume (~30+ videos/month per client) without quality slipping



Reliable internet and your own editing setup





Logistics — read this, it matters:



Base rate: $6.50/hr, part-time to start, flexible hours based on workload, worked during US Eastern daytime hours



Commission & bonuses, and they come FAST: when a last-minute or important booking comes in and I need an edit turned around quick, the editor who jumps on it and communicates gets paid extra — fast. This isn’t some far-off reward you wait months for. Show up when it counts and the extra money comes quick.



There is no ceiling on this role. I mean that. If you’re consistent and crushing it, I’ll take care of you above and beyond — more hours, more pay, more bonuses, and a real spot on a growing team. The right editor grows with this agency, not under it.



Most of the specifics (workflow, growth path, how we’ll work together) we’ll cover on a call. This post is step one.







How to apply — follow these exactly (this is part of the test):



Start your message with the word “GROWTH” so I know you read the whole post.

Send 2–3 examples of short-form videos you’ve edited (links).

In one or two sentences, tell me what makes a short-form video keep someone watching.

Include your best contact information 
, 
, WhatsApp).



Applications that don’t follow all four steps won’t be considered.

description:

JOB SUMMARY:

As our Amazon Brand Manager, you'll be the one steering how our products perform on Amazon day to day — from pricing and promotions to ad campaigns and everything in between. You'll keep an eye on our listings, spot opportunities to grow revenue, and help us stay ahead in our category.





RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage daily sales operations for assigned products, including pricing, promotions, and advertising campaigns

- Oversee product listings and identify new revenue opportunities within respective categories

- Monitor product performance to drive consistent sales growth and stronger category rankings

- Conduct in-depth product analysis and research market trends/competitors to guide strategic decisions

- Collaborate with the inventory planning team to manage promotions and excess inventory

- Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and confidentiality across all deliverables





QUALIFICATIONS:

• Strong brand management experience — from listing optimization and A+ Content to product launches and brand positioning

• PPC experience is a plus, but not required

• Strong analytical, data-driven decision-making skills

• Solid market research experience

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong documentation and time management skills

• High preference: applicants within NCR or nearby areas (e.g., Bulacan, Rizal).





NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS:

• You'll need to send a portfolio with a real ASIN you've personally handled from launch to finish (brand/product can be blurred), backed by substantial data — think sales or bestseller ranking graphs, not just a screenshot. If NDA-restricted or you no longer have account access, a short video walkthrough explaining the work and results is acceptable instead.

• Be ready to walk through and explain the actual performance data behind that ASIN during the interview — conversion rate, ACOS, organic vs. paid sales split. This will be a substantial part of the conversation, so come prepared to speak to real numbers, not general claims.





SETUP:

• Full-time, 9AM to 6PM PHT

• Uses Time Doctor for time tracking

• Own equipment needed (Laptop, Mouse, Earphones/Headphones)

• Stable internet connection, with a readily available backup connection

• Full-time contractual employment (renewal contract based on performance)

• There will be quarterly (with chances of it being monthly) meet-ups within NCR whenever the CEO visits the Philippines

JOB TYPE: Part-time, 20-25 hours/week, with a path to full-time

SCHEDULE: [4] hours of overlap with US Eastern time, [days/hours]



ABOUT US

KB Homes & Luxury at KW Empower is a top-producing real estate team serving Philadelphia, Montgomery and Bucks County, South Jersey, and the Jersey Shore. Our motto is "Education. Empowerment. Someone in your corner." We are looking for a detail-obsessed, proactive assistant who makes sure every client and every deal is handled with care.



TRANSACTION COORDINATION



 • Open each file in Lone Wolf the day the contract is signed and build the full deadline timeline

 • Track every contingency and deadline, and alert Keri at least [48 hours] before each one

 • Order and schedule inspections, appraisals, and title work

 • Send clients a welcome
 and "what happens next" checklist, then keep them updated

LISTINGS

 • Check that listings show correctly on syndication sites

 • Use AI to draft listing descriptions for Keri's approval

 • Order signs, lockboxes, and photography



PERSONAL ASSISTANT



 • Manage Keri's inbox, calendar, and showing schedule

 • Book appointments and send reminders

 • Help with event and travel logistics

 • Prepare client closing gifts

 • Set closing-anniversary and check-in reminders for every past client



REQUIREMENTS



 • 1+ year of US real estate transaction coordination (PA/NJ is a big plus)

 • Experience with Lone Wolf, or strong experience with a similar platform and a willingness to learn Lone Wolf

 • Familiarity with an MLS, ideally Bright MLS

 • Comfortable with Google Workspace and AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT

 • Excellent written English that is warm, clear, and error-free

 • Reliable internet, backup power, and a working laptop

 • Organized, proactive, and able to catch problems before they happen

 • Comfortable working independently and asking questions early



NICE TO HAVE



 • Experience with Follow Up Boss or KW Command

 • Experience with a luxury or high-touch client service business



TO APPLY (follow all steps or your application won't be read):



 1. Put "KEEP DEALS ON TRACK" as the first line of your message

 2. Tell us your US real estate experience and which platforms you've used

 3. Answer in 2-3 sentences: A contingency deadline is tomorrow and the lender hasn't responded. What do you do?

 4. Attach a 1-2 minute video intro (Loom is fine)

 5. Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid test task



We look forward to meeting you!

title: Web and App Developer (React/Next.js, WordPress, Flutter), Part-Time, US company
description:
Likeable Losers LLC is a small US software company in Arizona. We build websites, web apps, mobile apps and automations for our own clients. The owners find the clients; you build.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

Sites and web apps in Next.js or React. WordPress, Webflow and Shopify builds and fixes. Mobile app MVPs in Flutter or React Native. Backends on Supabase or Firebase. Stripe, booking and API integrations. Automations in n8n, Make or Zapier. Plus the small stuff: bug fixes, testing, short notes, research.



YOU

- 2+ years shipping real projects, with links to prove it.

- Strong in at least 3 of the areas above. Git daily.

- Clear written English. Most of this job is written messages.

- Online 2 to 3 hours between 9 PM and 12 AM Philippine time on weekdays. Other hours flexible.

- Own computer, stable internet, brownout backup.



PAY

$4 to $15 per hour, priced per task with a written brief before you start. Paid every Friday through Wise in USD. Hours start part-time and grow with the work we win.



ABOUT AI

Use AI on the job all you want. We do, and we expect you to. The three questions below are the one place we ask you not to: we want your own words about your own experience, and AI-written or copied answers go to the bottom of the pile.



HOW TO APPLY

1. First line of your application: the word BRIDGE.

2. Two links to things you built yourself, and what you did on each.

3. Which 2 to 3 hours in the 9 PM to 12 AM window you can commit to.

4. Answer these three in your own words. Short is fine. Specific is what we read for.



Q1. Tell us about the last deadline you missed or nearly missed. When did you tell the client, what exactly did you say, and what changed afterward?



Q2. Tell us about a time a client or boss asked for a change you disagreed with. What did you say, and what did you end up doing?



Q3. A client sends you one line: "Build me a booking page for my clinic, make it work on phones." What do you ask them before you start, and what would you assume for each if they never answer?



5. Record a voice note or phone video of 60 seconds or less answering Q1 again in your own words. Upload it anywhere (Google Drive, Loom, Vocaroo) and paste the link. No editing, no script. We want to hear you.



We read every application that does all five.

title: GoHighLevel  Specialist
description:
Job Title: GoHighLevel (GHL) Administrator

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-Time / Contract



Job Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive GoHighLevel (GHL) Administrator to take ownership of our CRM ecosystem. You will be the go-to expert for building, maintaining, and optimizing GHL sub-accounts to ensure our marketing, sales, and client-fulfillment processes run seamlessly.



This is not just a data-entry role; we need a "systems builder" who can architect reliable automations, manage complex calendars, maintain data integrity through custom values, and leverage AI tools effectively with well-crafted prompts. The ideal candidate is a methodical problem-solver who rigorously tests every build and takes pride in creating bug-free, revenue-generating systems.



Key Responsibilities

1. Workflows & Automation Management



Build, branch, and troubleshoot multi-step GHL workflows using triggers, if/else logic, wait states, and goal events.



Design and maintain automation for lead nurturing, appointment reminders, follow-up sequences, review requests, and missed-call text-back flows.



Configure lead routing, task assignments, internal notifications, and pipeline stage automations to maximize conversion speed.



Diagnose and fix broken automations, misfiring triggers, infinite loops, and duplicate contact issues.



2. Calendar & Scheduling Administration



Set up and optimize various GHL calendar types, including round-robin, collective, and class-booking calendars.



Build and manage booking widgets, appointment confirmation sequences, and no-show recovery automation.



Ensure seamless integration between calendars and other GHL features (e.g., workflows, forms) and external calendar systems.



3. Custom Values & Data Integrity



Create and map custom fields and custom values for each sub-account to ensure bots, forms, and workflows pull the correct dynamic data (e.g., names, dates, deal amounts, and location-specific details).



Maintain a clean, standardized tagging system and smart lists to keep lead segmentation accurate and reliable.



Perform regular system health checks, including merging duplicate contacts, auditing active triggers, and cleaning up stale data.



4. Basic Prompting & AI Utilization



Write, test, and refine system prompts for GHL's Conversation AI and Workflow AI actions to ensure reliable, on-brand interactions for lead qualification, booking, and routing.



Understand when AI is the right tool for a task versus when a simpler, deterministic automation is more effective.



Iterate on prompts to improve the accuracy and tone of AI-driven customer communications.



5. Funnels, Forms, and General Administration



Build and maintain GHL funnels, landing pages, forms, and surveys, ensuring proper field mapping and integration with workflows and calendars.



Manage user onboarding, roles, and permissions across client sub-accounts.



Maintain
 and SMS deliverability standards, including basic domain setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and compliance awareness (e.g., A2P 10DLC).



Integrate GHL with third-party tools using native integrations, webhooks, Zapier, or Make.



Required Skills & Qualifications

2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel administration experience managing live sub-accounts.



Expert-level workflow skills: Proven ability to build complex branching logic without creating lead leaks or broken loops.



Strong calendar management: Experience with round-robin routing, booking automation, and appointment lifecycle management.



Mastery of custom values and fields: Ability to architect and map dynamic data across the platform.



Basic prompt engineering: Experience writing and iterating prompts for AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT or GHL AI features) to achieve reliable outcomes.



Methodical mindset: You double-check inputs, manually test lead flows through every branch, and care deeply about quality assurance before launch.



Clear communication: Strong written English and high responsiveness for remote collaboration.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GHL's AI features, including Conversation AI, Voice AI, or Workflow AI actions.



Familiarity with webhooks, APIs, and middleware automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n).



Knowledge of
 deliverability best practices and SMS compliance regulations.



Prior experience working in an agency or multi-client environment.



What We Offer

A remote, flexible work environment.



The opportunity to own and architect critical business systems.



Competitive compensation based on experience.



To Apply: Please submit your resume and a brief note describing a complex GHL workflow or calendar setup you have built and how you ensured its reliability through testing and custom value management.

title: Application Assistant
description:

The daily target is 150 quality applications. As time goes on we will bump it up!



What You'll Do



 • Search LinkedIn, Indeed, ZipRecruiter and Dice for remote inpatient coding roles (Inpatient Coder, DRG Coder, Facility Coder, HIM Coding Specialist, ICD-10-PCS Coder, and similar)

 • Check each listing to confirm it's an inpatient role and not outpatient or physician-side billing

 • Make sure the client meets the minimum experience and tool requirements before applying

 • Submit applications using the approved resume and cover letter templates

 • Log every application in Google Sheets with the job title, company, location, platform, date and status

 • Run quality checks on your own submissions during the day

 • Send an end-of-day report by Slack or
 with the total submitted, a tracker screenshot, any interview requests, and listings the client should review

 • Help with the weekly review of which platforms and keywords are bringing in callbacks



Requirements



 • Experience with high-volume job applications, recruiting support, or data entry

 • Strong English reading and writing skills

 • Very high attention to detail, because accuracy matters as much as speed

 • Comfortable with LinkedIn, Indeed, ZipRecruiter and Dice

 • Experience with Google Sheets

 • Stable internet connection and a reliable computer

 • Available during the hours listed above



Nice to Have



 • Background in healthcare, medical billing or medical coding (knowing terms like DRG, ICD-10-PCS, CCS and HIM)

 • Experience with Grammarly and JobScan

 • Experience using Slack



Tools: Google Sheets, Grammarly, JobScan, Slack/email

title: Youtube Video Editor
description:
FULL-TIME YouTube Video Editor – Hormozi / Iman Gadzhi Style



Job Type: Full-Time, Long-Term



Pay: (around $30 per 15-minute video)



Workload: 1 completed YouTube video per day



Job Description



I'm looking for a skilled, reliable YouTube video editor to work with me full-time.



My channel focuses on remote jobs, making money online, and overemployment.



I want editing similar to Alex Hormozi and Iman Gadzhi — engaging captions, high-quality B-roll, clean animations, sound effects, and strong pacing.



These are talking-head videos, but I want someone who can turn basic footage into engaging, professional content.



What You'll Be Doing

- Editing 10–20 minute YouTube videos.

- Finding relevant, high-quality B-roll footage yourself.

- Adding engaging captions, zooms, and transitions.

- Using screenshots, websites, Reddit posts, and graphics.

- Adding simple motion graphics and sound effects.

- Creating engaging visual storytelling that keeps viewers watching.

- Bonus: Wojak-style 2D animations and storytelling.



I do NOT want random stock footage, unnecessary 3D animations, or generic effects. Every visual should make the video better.



IMPORTANT – DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You cannot consistently edit one 15-minute YouTube video per working day.

- You cannot find relevant, high-quality B-roll footage independently.

- You do not have examples of long-form YouTube videos you've personally edited.

- You are requesting more than $30 per 15-minute video.

- You cannot commit to full-time work or meet deadlines.

- You cannot communicate clearly in English.



I'm looking for serious editors who actually have the skills and availability for this position. **If you don't meet these requirements, please do not apply.**



How to Apply



Start your application with the word "CAREER".



You MUST include:



1. A link to a 10–20 minute YouTube video you personally edited. Tell me exactly what you edited in that video.

2. Your hourly rate and expected price per 15-minute video.

3. How many hours it takes you to edit a 15-minute video.

4. Confirmation that you can deliver one completed video per working day.

5. Your editing software and any experience with animation b-roll (Wojack editing for example)



Applications without actual video examples will not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short editing test.



I'm looking for someone reliable who wants steady, long-term work. If you're skilled, efficient, and can consistently deliver great videos, I'd love to work with you!

title: QA Software Test Engineer (Remote)
description:
Job Type: Full-Time | 100% Remote

Position: QA Automation Engineer / Software Test Engineer

Experience: 4+ Years (Mid-Senior / Senior Level)



Job Description



We are looking for an experienced QA Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, stability, and reliability of our web platforms and mobile applications (iOS & Android).



The ideal candidate must be highly skilled in AI-powered automated testing, Playwright, unit testing, API testing, and end-to-end (E2E) testing.



We strongly prefer candidates who can leverage modern AI tools and AI agents to independently create, execute, maintain, and improve automated test suites.



We are not looking for someone who only performs manual testing. You must be capable of building automated testing solutions and proactively identifying bugs before they reach production.



Key Responsibilities



Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for websites, web applications, and mobile apps.



Use Playwright to implement comprehensive E2E tests covering critical user journeys.



Leverage AI agents and AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) to generate, execute, and improve automated test scripts.



Develop and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and regression tests.



Test iOS and Android applications, including Flutter, WebView-based, and hybrid apps.



Perform API testing, including authentication, payment flows, and backend integrations.



Identify functional bugs, UI/UX issues, compatibility problems, and performance bottlenecks.



Ensure critical features such as registration, login, payments, subscriptions, and core product workflows function correctly.



Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.



Independently verify that new features meet product requirements before release.



Clearly document bugs with reproduction steps, screenshots, logs, and videos.



Collaborate closely with developers and product managers to resolve issues efficiently.



Requirements



At least 4 years of professional QA or software testing experience.



Strong hands-on experience with Playwright for browser automation.



Solid understanding of unit testing, integration testing, E2E testing, and regression testing.



Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript for writing automated test scripts.



Experience with testing frameworks such as Jest, Vitest, or similar.



Familiarity with mobile automation tools such as Appium, Maestro, or Flutter integration_test.



Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, Playwright API testing, or equivalent tools.



Strong ability to use AI agents to automate testing workflows and improve testing efficiency.



Ability to understand product requirements and independently design comprehensive test cases.



Experience with Git, GitHub Actions, or other CI/CD tools.



Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.



Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify obvious issues before release.



Good written English communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience using AI agents to autonomously explore applications, generate test cases, and execute regression tests.



Experience with Flutter, React, Vue, Next.js, or Nuxt.js applications.



Knowledge of mobile testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators.



Familiarity with payment gateway testing, including Stripe.



Experience with performance testing tools such as k6 or Lighthouse.



Ability to write basic frontend or backend code to debug issues and create test utilities.



Experience building automated QA workflows from scratch.



What We Expect



We value automation, independence, efficiency, and ownership.



Our ideal QA engineer should be able to:



Understand product requirements without constant supervision.



Proactively identify edge cases and potential failures.



Use AI tools to quickly build reliable automated tests.



Catch bugs before developers submit features for release.



Reduce repetitive manual testing through automation.



Take full responsibility for product quality across web and mobile platforms.



If your experience is limited to manual testing or you have no practical experience with automation frameworks and AI-assisted testing, please do not apply.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with:



Your experience with Playwright or other automation frameworks.



Examples of automated testing projects you have built.



A brief explanation of how you currently use AI tools or AI agents in your QA workflow.



Your experience testing web applications and iOS/Android apps.



Your expected monthly salary and earliest available start date.

title: Creative 10.30-4.30pm - Tue, Thur, Sat

10.30 -4pm Tues, Thurs Satuday.



We're a new, remote micro-startup team building and operating several of our own e-commerce and web businesses, while also developing systems and creative solutions for other businesses.

We're looking to bring ONE Creative into the team in this intake, working approximately 12 hours per week.



This is a hands-on, varied role that goes beyond simply producing creative work. You'll work across our own businesses as well as projects for external clients, helping develop new systems, processes and creative workflows that make businesses operate more effectively.



A core part of your role will be building the systems, checklists and quality-control processes that allow work to be produced consistently and efficiently by others. You'll also work closely with AI tools to develop ideas, accelerate production and deliver high-quality creative work.



Strong administration, organisation and process-building skills are just as important as your creative experience and ability. We're looking for someone who can combine creative thinking with a practical, organised approach and enjoys finding better ways to get things done.





THE WORK

Brand assets, social graphics, ad creative, web visuals and product imagery for live businesses. Content that ships the same week. Some video and motion.



You publish your own social posts and web updates — you won't be handing off to a separate team.



WHO FITS

- You've built or run something real — even small, even if it failed — and can show it



- You pick up tools without being taught step by step



- Consistent and reliable - working the same three days and hours every week



- You ask a direct question instead of quietly guessing



- Comfortable with AI creative tools — not intimidated, not dependent



- Happy to work outside pure design. We want adaptable generalists, not narrow specialists.



WHO DOESN'T FIT

Not suited to those who need structured training or close supervision to learn new skills. You should be disciplined, resourceful and comfortable taking the initiative to research, experiment and teach yourself. You will have mentors, but not trainers…. 

-Portfolio-only work with nothing shipped.

-Anyone who needs a manager checking in before they start.

-Unreliable availability.



HOURS

Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday — 10:30am to 4:00pm Philippine time.

4 paid hours per day plus a 90-minute unpaid break.

First and last hour compulsory, break flexible in between.

Overtime available on demand.



PAY

₱110 p.h. A paid trial of two weeks, then you start as a permanent contractor at the same rate.

Rate reviewed every 3 months, each review adding up to AUD 50 cents an hour.



LOCATION

Philippines only this intake. Remote work from home.



APPLICATIONS

Open now and read as they arrive. The role closes when it is filled, so applying early is an advantage.

THE TIMELINE — CHECK YOUR AVAILABILITY BEFORE YOU APPLY

Shortlisted applicants' assessment takes an hour or two on each of three days. 

All times below are Philippine time.



- Applications are read as they arrive. A strong one may be shortlisted straight away.

- Shortlist announced. Everyone hears back either way.

 If you're in, your Day 1 project arrives and the clock starts.



- Day 1 — your first project (a 24-hour window; about 1-2 hours of work).

- Day 2 — you get a critique of Day 1, rework it, and propose your own improvement sized one to three hours.

- Day 3 — the final project. This one carries the most weight.



Every Shortlist  assessment day is paid.



- Day 4 or 5 — a short live interview for the candidates still in contention; the hiring decision within a day or two, and successful applicants start straight after.



Each project day is a 24-hour window needing an hour or two of work, not a full day of work — but you need to be free to work inside each one. We may also ask for a short voice call after your first project. Most people won't get one; we use it to talk to strong candidates early, or to sort out a problem fast rather than let it cost you a day. Please be reachable on
 across the assessment days.



If your days aren't free, or you can't interview and start on time, this isn't the right time for you. Tell us when you apply that you'd like to be considered for a later opening instead.



WHAT YOU NEED

Good spoken and written English and fast reliable internet — both tested early.

Spellcheckers and grammar tools are expected and fine.
 is our team channel.

title: Travel Operations and Systems Specialist – Golf Tournament and Boutique Travel Packaging, Marketing and Customer Support
description:
Travel Operations and Systems Specialist – Golf Tournament and Boutique Travel Packaging, Marketing and Customer Support

We produce an international golf television show and host boutique luxury golf tournaments and bespoke travel packages.



We are looking for a detail-oriented, analytical and design-capable Operations and Systems Specialist to complete an initial project sprint focused on supplier outreach, wholesale cost research, package formulation, spreadsheet modelling, collateral design in Canva and SOP documentation.



For the right candidate who successfully executes this setup sprint, this project may lead to longer-term work managing guest bookings, customer enquiries, marketing operations and new tournament pricing later in 2027.



Initial Project Deliverables (Phase 1):



•	Supplier Research and Wholesale Contracting: Conduct thorough research to identify and contact luxury hotels, championship golf courses and private transport operators across our tournament regions (Vietnam and Thailand) to gather accurate net wholesale rates, group allocations and terms.

•	Commercial Cost Modelling and Terms: Build and update structured Excel costing sheets to calculate wholesale-to-retail pricing structures, margins, payment schedules and deposit policies for our upcoming May 2027 tournaments.

•	Standard Package Creation: Build standardized 7-night/5-round packages (plus 3-night/2-round post-tour extensions and add-ons like massage, club hire and extra rounds) using Travefy.

•	Collateral Updates and Canva Design: Update and polish pricing tables, package itineraries and visual promotional assets using our existing Canva templates and coordinate publishing to the website in cooperation with our graphic designer and IT assistant.

•	Marketing Operations and Campaign Setup: Assist with organizing marketing collateral, campaign schedules and dispatch workflows across
 newsletters and digital channels using our media vault.

•	Booking Funnel Setup: Configure customer intake tracking spreadsheets, deposit schedules and payment links (Airwallex and direct transfer).

•	SOP and Video Documentation: Record step-by-step Loom video walkthroughs and write clear SOP guides for every task completed (supplier outreach, Travefy packaging, Canva edits and pricing math) so these workflows can be repeated effortlessly across new destinations.



Future Scope (Post-Sprint):



Once this packaging foundation, collateral design and SOP library are complete, the role may naturally expand into taking care of guest booking enquiries, running ongoing marketing distribution and packaging new tournament destinations later in 2027.



Skills and Qualifications:



•	Strong operational background in workflow coordination, marketing operations or travel reservations.

•	Must have direct working knowledge and practical experience with Travefy (or similar itinerary builders) and Expedia TAAP.

•	Practical graphic design capability using Canva to edit, format and polish high-end marketing collateral and brochures from existing templates.

•	Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets) with high accuracy in cost modelling, formulas and margins.

•	Strong research and fact-finding capability to locate reliable supplier contacts, terms and rates without supervision.

•	Comfortable using modern AI tools (such as Claude) to accelerate research, review formulas and draft correspondence.

•	Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

•	Strong systems orientation with the discipline to document processes via Loom videos and written SOPs.



CRITICAL APPLICATION INSTRUCTION:



Do not use AI to generate your proposal or answers to these questions. We require authentic, personal responses written in your own voice. We want to see your actual thought process, personality, practical background and what makes you stand out. Submissions containing generic, AI-generated text will be archived immediately.



Please answer the questions below directly in your proposal and include your video link. Generic or incomplete submissions will not be considered.



1.	Research, Travel Operations and Supplier Contracting: Outline your practical experience conducting deep research and negotiating rates, room allocations, green fees and transfers directly with resorts, hotels and localized tour operators/DMCs, as well as packaging itineraries using Travefy and Expedia TAAP.



2.	Canva and Marketing Operations Background: Describe your experience updating and designing promotional collateral, brochures or social graphics in Canva, as well as your background coordinating marketing campaigns or
 newsletters.



3.	Spreadsheet Modelling and Numbers: How do you set up an Excel sheet to model multi-variable package costs (such as fluctuating hotel seasonal rates, transport van sizing across player numbers, green fees and currency conversions) while ensuring profit margins remain protected?



4.	Natural Problem-Solving and Working Style: When handed a fast-moving commercial objective, what is your natural instinct: do you pause to build structured workflows, spreadsheets and SOPs first, or do you prefer to move fast and improvise on intuition?



5.	Flow State: Where do you find your greatest flow: deal-making, analyzing data or building backend operational systems?



6.	High-Ticket Closing and Retention: How do you consultatively close high-ticket bookings and identify upsell opportunities while delivering attentive concierge service that ensures guests rebook tournament after tournament / year after year?



7.	90-Second Video Introduction (Mandatory): Please record and paste a link to a maximum 90-second video introduction (hosted on Loom, Google Drive, YouTube Unlisted or Dropbox) addressing these three points:



o	What lights you up: Tell us about your highest personal values and what you are most passionate about in life when you are not working.

o	Your human superpower: What is the single distinctive trait or character strength that truly sets you apart from anyone else?

o	The one thing: What is the 1 thing that excites you most about this role opportunity?



8.	Attention-to-Detail Research Test: Who are the two sisters who founded Nectar Cold Pressed in Australia? (Important: Please do not use AI for your answer. If this answer is incorrect or missing, your proposal will not be considered and will be archived automatically).

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant to the Founder

Sloan Healthcare Innovations  |  Part-Time (20 hrs/week)  |  Remote  |  US Mountain Time  |  Long-Term

Job Overview

I am the founder of Sloan Healthcare Innovations and a growth leader across several healthcare and insurance companies. I build partnerships with brokers, general agents, associations, TPAs, and other healthcare organizations, and I bring new healthcare solutions to market through them.

My week is spread across multiple companies, multiple calendars and inboxes, frequent travel, and many conversations with prospects, partners, and clients. I need an Executive Assistant who keeps all of it organized and moving forward, so I can spend my time selling, building partnerships, and leading.

You will see confidential business information, client relationships, and partner agreements. Trust, discretion, and integrity are the most important qualities for this role.

What You'll Own

1. Calendar and Schedule Management (multiple companies)

•	Manage several calendars across different companies and
 accounts, mainly Microsoft 365 / Outlook / Teams, plus Calendar management 

•	Keep one accurate view of my schedule across all calendars, with no double-bookings and no missed meetings

•	Schedule, reschedule, and confirm meetings with prospects, partners, and clients across US time zones

•	Protect my priorities and keep my calendar aligned to where my time matters most

2. Meeting Preparation and Notes

•	Before key meetings, send me a short brief: who I am meeting, their company, our history, and the goal of the meeting

•	Capture notes from Teams meetings, using transcripts or AI note-takers where available

•	Same day, turn the notes into a clean summary: decisions made, action items, owners, and due dates

3. Prospect, Partner, and Client Follow-Up

•	Draft and send follow-up
s after meetings in my voice, for my approval at first and then independently as trust builds

•	Keep a follow-up tracker so every relationship has a clear next step and date

•	Send reminders when a prospect or partner has gone quiet

•	Keep contacts, notes, and deal status updated in our CRM

4. Weekly Partner Recap

•	Every Friday, draft a weekly update for the leadership of each of my partner companies: progress, wins, and priorities for next week

•	Send the drafts to me first for review, then send them out once approved

5. Travel Coordination

•	Book and organize business travel: flights, hotels, rental cars, and itineraries

•	Track and use my airline loyalty programs (United, American, Delta) to protect status and use points well

•	Build travel days around meetings so trips are efficient and productive

6. Inbox and Document Support

•	Triage my inboxes: flag what needs me, file what does not, and draft replies to routine messages

•	Keep documents organized using a standard folder structure and naming convention

•	Track key documents such as signed agreements, partner contracts, and proposals

A Typical Week

When	What

Daily	Calendar check across all accounts, inbox triage, meeting briefs, same-day notes and follow-ups

Monday	Review the week ahead with me (15-minute call); confirm priorities and open follow-ups

Friday	Draft weekly partner recaps for my review; update the follow-up tracker

As needed	Travel booking, document organization, CRM updates



What You Bring

Required

•	2+ years as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant to a US-based founder, executive, or sales leader

•	Strong experience with Microsoft 365: Outlook, Teams, and managing multiple calendars

•	Excellent written English, since you will write to my clients and partners on my behalf

•	Experience taking meeting notes and turning them into action items

•	Experience booking US business travel

•	Stable internet, backup power or internet, and a quiet workspace

•	Professional references I can contact

Nice to Have

•	Background in health insurance, employee benefits, or healthcare

•	CRM experience (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Salesforce, or similar)

•	Experience with AI note-taking tools and airline loyalty programs

The Kind of Person I'm Looking For

•	Trustworthy: you handle confidential information with complete discretion

•	Proactive: you spot a calendar conflict or a missed follow-up before I do

•	Detail-oriented: names, times, time zones, and commitments are always right

•	Clear communicator: you ask questions early and give updates without being asked

•	Coachable: I give specific feedback and expect it to be applied going forward

Schedule and Pay

•	20 hours/week, Monday to Friday, about 4 hours a day during US Mountain Time business hours (night shift in the Philippines)

•	$4.50 – $7 USD/hour, based on experience

•	Paid trial period before a long-term commitment

•	Potential to grow into a full-time role as the business grows

How to Apply

Please send:

1.	Your resume

2.	A short introduction (3–5 sentences) about why you are a fit

3.	A sample follow-up
: imagine you just sat in on a meeting where I introduced a new health benefits product to an insurance broker. Write the follow-up
 you would send on my behalf.

4.	A 1–2 minute video or voice recording introducing yourself

Put "TRUSTED EA" in your subject line. Applications without it will not be reviewed

title: Full-Time Full-Stack Developer (AI-Native) - Next.js, Astro, Supabase
description:
Role Snapshot



We're looking for a full-time developer to take ownership of our project work - mostly Next.js and Astro apps on Vercel, backed by Supabase, plus React apps served through nginx. You'll be shipping on projects that are already live, and taking the lead on new builds when they come up, with the founder setting the direction. The goal is simple: the projects keep moving without the founder reviewing every step.



Mission of the Role



Our projects are live and growing, and right now too much of the build work sits with the founder. This role exists to move that weight onto someone who can be trusted with it. The mission: keep our existing apps healthy, carry new builds from brief to launch, and make technical decisions that hold up six months from now - not just ones that pass today.



Core Responsibilities



- Shipping on existing projects and new builds (45%) - Pick up tickets across our Next.js and Astro apps on Vercel, plus our React apps behind nginx, and deliver small features, fixes and refinements. When we start something new, you'll work with the founder to shape the approach, then build it and keep it moving. The founder sets the outcome; you work out the how and flag anything you're unsure about early.



- Supabase and data work (20%) - Schema changes, queries, auth, storage and policies. You'll own data decisions on your own tickets and flag anything that could affect existing data before it goes near production.

AI-assisted development, properly reviewed (15%) - We're AI-native and expect you to move fast with AI tools. That means reading, testing and correcting what the AI produces before it ships - not pasting output and hoping. Comfort with AI is required; judgement is what we're actually hiring for.



- Codebase health and deployment hygiene (10%) - Clear commits and pull requests, sensible branch work, environment variables handled correctly, and no cowboy pushes to main. If something breaks, you can roll it back and explain what happened.



- Communication and handover (10%) - Update the board, write a short summary of what changed and why, and raise risks early. On new work, that means telling the founder what you need and what you're assuming before you're three days in. The founder should never have to chase you for status.





Success Metrics



- Tickets shipped without line-by-line review - By day 90, routine work goes out on your judgement alone, with the founder reviewing outcomes rather than syntax.



- New work moves forward - You can take a brief, come back with a sensible approach and a rough plan, and keep the build progressing without waiting on instructions.



- Low rework rate - Fewer than one in five shipped tasks needs to be reopened or fixed a second time.

No unexplained breakage - Every deploy is either clean or rolled back fast with a clear explanation. Silent failures are the one thing we won't tolerate.



- Clear written updates - Every ticket and project leaves a short trail: what changed, how it was tested, anything left open.

Response time inside core hours - Reachable and responsive during agreed Sydney-hours overlap.



Weekly "Big 3" Goals

- Keep the active board moving - nothing sits untouched for days without a status.

- Leave the codebase better than you found it, even on small tickets.

- Communicate before you go dark - flag blockers, risks and open questions the same day you spot them.



Monthly Reflection Questions

- What shipped this month, and what slipped? Was the slip a capacity issue or a clarity issue?

- Where did AI output need the most correction? What does that tell me about my own gaps?

- What broke in production, and what would have caught it earlier?

- What am I doing that should be automated, documented, or handed back?

- Which decision did I make this month that I'd make differently now?



Our Culture in Action

We're AI-native, not AI-dependent. We use AI tools openly and expect you to as well, but we hire people who understand what they're implementing and can defend it in a conversation. We value self-direction: ask good questions up front, then get on with it. We also value people who raise risks rather than quietly shipping them - a flagged problem is a good day, a hidden one is a bad month. Communication is plain, direct and written down. We're a small team, so ownership matters more than titles, and there's room to grow into bigger builds as you get comfortable with our projects.



Logistics & Tools

- Commitment: Full-time, [40 hours per week]

- Hours: Core overlap with Sydney time, Monday to Friday. Once we're comfortable with each other, the rest of your day becomes flexible.

- Location: Remote

- Reporting to: Founder

- Compensation: ₱39,500 - ₱48,300 per month paid weekly

- Stack and tools: Vercel, Next.js, Astro, React, nginx, Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage, RLS), GitHub, plus AI coding assistants of your choice (Claude, Cursor, Copilot or similar) and a task board - [add Linear, Notion, Trello or whatever you use]

- Must-haves: Real development experience, not just tutorial level - mid-level and up is fine. Comfortable reading unfamiliar code and debugging in production. Able to look at a new brief and ask the right questions before building. Can explain your own work without leaning on the AI that wrote it. Solid Git workflow habits.

- Nice to have: You've taken something from brief to live launch before, even a small internal tool or side project.



Final Note



If you've read this far and thought "that's exactly how I like to work", I'd like to hear from you. When you apply, skip the generic cover letter. Instead send me:



- A link to your GitHub, plus one project you're proud of and what your actual role in it was

- One short paragraph on how you use AI tools day to day, and where you deliberately don't

- A quick example of a bug that took you longer than expected, and how you found it

- Tell me the truth about what you're strong at and where you'd want support. I'd rather hire someone honest about their edges than someone who claims everything.

title: Experienced Cold Caller — US Business Owners (B2B Outbound) | 6+ Hours Daily
description:
Read this whole post before applying. Applications that don’t follow the instructions at the bottom will not get a reply.



We book meetings for US plumbing and HVAC companies. You call the business owner cold — he did not ask for the call and is not expecting it — qualify him in a few questions, and book a specific meeting time. We run the meeting and close it.



We give you the lead list, the script, the dialler and the training. You are not finding leads and you are not selling. You make the calls and book the meetings.



This role is NOT for beginners. If you have never cold called a stranger who did not ask to hear from you, please do not apply.



Requirements — all of them, no exceptions:

• At least 1–2 years of outbound COLD calling. Truly cold: people who did not request a call. Inbound, customer service, warm leads, opted-in leads and follow-ups do not count.

• Experience calling business owners (B2B) is a strong plus. Calling US homeowners also counts.

• Fully fluent, clear English. A busy US owner must understand you in the first three seconds.

• 6+ hours of dialling a day, Monday to Friday, starting 8:00 AM US Eastern (9:00 PM Manila). This is a night shift. Only apply if you can hold it every week.

• Comfortable with high volume, 150+ dials a day, and with hearing “no” all day without it affecting the next call.

• Your own computer, headset, quiet room and stable internet, plus a real backup for power and internet (inverter, generator, mobile data).

• Every call is recorded. If that bothers you, this isn’t for you.



Who we want: someone driven and hungry who always wants more. Someone who doesn’t stop at 150 dials because the number is hit, but keeps going as long as the leads and the hours allow. Takes coaching, fixes what isn’t working, and never blames the list.



Timeline: we’re hiring over the next two weeks and review every complete application within 3 days.



To apply, your application message must include all of the following:



- Your WhatsApp number with country code

- How many years of cold outbound calling you have, and who you were calling (business owners or homeowners, and which country)

- Your average dials per day in your last cold-calling role

- In 3–4 sentences: the hardest cold call you’ve made, and what you actually said

- A link to a 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) of you reading this as if on a real call: “Hi, is this the owner? I’ll be quick — I work with plumbing and HVAC companies on the estimates that never turned into jobs. Roughly how many estimates does your team send out in a week?”



Applications missing any of the five will not get a reply.

title: Senior Next.js + Laravel Developer (React / TypeScript) – 2 Positions
description:
Senior Next.js + Laravel Developer (React / TypeScript) – 2 Positions



2 positions · Fully remote · Full-time · Mon–Fri, 7am–4pm PHT · Senior level (5+ years) · Individual developers only (no agencies)



**Only Apply here in Online Jobs, our team is unable to review your application if it's not submitted here in online jobs. Don't
 directly or message on linkedin. Attention to detail and following instructions is important.**



We're Caravea, an Australian software company building for the caravan and RV industry. Our main product is a multi-tenant Laravel platform (Inertia + React + TypeScript) that dealers use every day to run their stock, leads and workshops. We also build Next.js websites for those dealers and brands, and we're migrating more than 100 client sites onto Next.js + Laravel.



We're growing, and we're hiring two senior developers: people who have shipped and maintained production Next.js and Laravel applications for years, make good decisions without being told, and raise the standard of the team around them. Both roles are the same; you'll work alongside each other and our existing developers.



This is not a learning role. If you're still building your Next.js or Laravel experience, please don't apply this time. If you don't know Next.JS or Laravel please don't apply.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



• Our Next.js platform for client websites. Its architecture, caching and performance, and the migration of 100+ sites onto it.

• Features end to end in our modular Laravel platform: API, UI, tests and release, working inside company-scoped (multi-tenant) data, permissions and queues

• Technical decisions: you'll spot the problems nobody assigned, propose options, and write down the trade-offs

• Code quality: you'll review other developers' pull requests and help shape our conventions

• Delivery: clear written updates, honest estimates, and early warning when something will slip



A query that forgets to scope by company isn't a small bug. It's a data leak. You should already think like that.



YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE



• 5+ years of commercial full-stack development, with at least 2 years on production Next.js and 3 on production Laravel

• Next.js in depth: App Router, server vs client components, Server Actions, caching and revalidation, rendering strategies, metadata/SEO, performance

• Laravel in depth: Form Requests, Eloquent (and avoiding N+1 queries), policies, queues, transactions and locking, Pest or PHPUnit tests

• React + TypeScript: well-typed, reusable components

• Experience owning something in production: a product, module or set of sites you were responsible for, including fixing it when it broke

• Experience reviewing other people's code

• Clear written English, and the habit of giving updates without being asked



NICE TO HAVE



• Inertia.js

• Multi-tenant SaaS

• Modular monolith architecture, Horizon/Redis, Reverb/WebSockets

• Tailwind + shadcn/ui, Playwright

• Mentoring or leading other developers



HOW WE USE AI



We expect you to use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, whatever works) every day, and to know when not to trust them. The rule is simple: you must be able to explain and defend every line you ship, whether you or an AI wrote it. 



HOW TO APPLY



Every applicant completes the same short application task. We judge the work, not the CV.



The application task (3-hour time box)



Build a small workshop bookings module for a caravan dealer: customers book their caravan in for a service in one of the dealer's service bays.



Laravel API



• CRUD for bookings, with SQLite so it runs with no setup

• Fields: customer_name, customer
, rego (caravan registration), service_bay, starts_at, ends_at, status (pending / confirmed / cancelled), notes (optional)

• Validation with Form Requests

• One business rule: no overlapping bookings in the same service bay (cancelled bookings don't count). It must hold even if two people try to book the same slot at the same moment.

• Pest tests covering the important behaviour



Next.js frontend (App Router + TypeScript)



This is where we'll look most closely.



• /bookings: a list using server components for data fetching, with pagination and a status filter driven by the URL (e.g. /bookings?status=confirmed&page=2)

• /bookings/[id]: a detail page, with a proper result when the booking doesn't exist

• Create and edit using Server Actions, with Laravel's validation errors (including the overlap rule) shown next to the right form fields

• The list updates after a change, without a full page reload

• Loading and error states



Styling is up to you. Don't spend your time on it.



Senior write-up (in your README, half a page at most):



• Your caching and revalidation choices, and why

• How your overlap rule handles two simultaneous bookings

• If this became one module in a multi-tenant platform used by 200 dealers, what you'd change first



Don't over-build. Three focused hours beats ten hours of polish. If you run out of time, write down what you'd do next.



What to send



1. A link to a public GitHub repo with your task. Your README must include:

   – How to run it

   – Your senior write-up (above)

   – Which AI tools you used, and one place where AI got something wrong and you fixed it

2. A link to a Loom video (5 minutes or less) walking through your task code, with your screen and your voice:

   – How it's structured, and which parts are server vs client components, and why

   – How a validation error travels from Laravel to the form

   – The decision you're most and least sure about



   The video must be on Loom (
; the free plan is fine). Set sharing to "anyone with the link can view" and leave the transcript turned on. We don't review YouTube, Google Drive or other platforms.

3. One line confirming you're available full-time (40 hrs/week), Mon–Fri 7am–4pm PHT, and that you're applying as an individual, not through an agency

4. Your CV, plus a link to a production Next.js or Laravel project you've owned, and what you were responsible for on it



Applications missing any of the above won't be reviewed.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application task review. We reply to every complete application.

2. Microsoft Teams interview (60–75 minutes) with our CEO and two senior developers:

   – We'll ask you to make a small change to your task code live

   – We'll review a short Laravel pull request together, out loud, as you would in a real code review

   – A short design discussion: how you'd structure part of our real platform

   – How you work remotely, and how you've led or supported other developers



That's it. There are no further take-home tests.



WHAT YOU GET



• Senior ownership of real products used by Australian businesses every day

• A say in architecture and how the team builds

• Experienced developers to work alongside

• Fully remote, Mon–Fri, 8-hour shift

• ₱ Based on experience

• Health insurance

• 13th-month pay

• Overtime pay

• A team that expects you to use the best tools available, including AI



If you've shipped and owned production Next.js and Laravel, you're careful with other people's data, and you make the developers around you better, we'd like to see your work.



Only apply via OnlineJobs. Use your favourite coding language + your favourite AI model as the subject line. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

Turnaround: long-form first cut within 5 business days; Shorts and cutdowns within 3 days.

Revisions: 3 consolidated rounds per deliverable included.

Required

 for day-to-day messaging and have live calls when needed

Send published links we can watch in a browser, not files to download. If you were not the only editor working on a project, specify exactly which parts of the video were completed by you.

3. Availability: your time zone, the hours per week you can commit, and whether the turnaround above is realistic for you.

title: Remote Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator
description:
About Us

The Denton Handyman is a growing residential handyman company serving Denton County, Texas, and surrounding communities.



We're looking for a dependable, organized, and confident Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator to help manage our daily operations.



This is much more than answering phones. You'll be responsible for helping turn inquiries into booked appointments, managing customer communication, preparing estimates, coordinating technicians, and ensuring our customers receive outstanding service.

Key Responsibilities

- Answer incoming customer phone calls, text messages, and
s professionally.

- Prepare estimates using established pricing guidelines.

- Convert qualified customer inquiries into scheduled appointments.

- Communicate scheduling changes, customer concerns, and important job information.

- Conduct customer satisfaction calls following completed residential services.

- Communicate with property managers regarding work orders, approvals, and scheduling.

- Maintain accurate and organized customer records.

- Follow established operating procedures while exercising sound independent judgment.

- Provide daily updates regarding appointments, outstanding estimates, and customer issues.

Qualifications

Required:

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Clear, professional, and friendly telephone communication.

- Previous experience in customer service, appointment scheduling, dispatching, or administrative support.

- Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

- Ability to communicate confidently with American customers.

- Comfortable learning and using multiple software applications.

- Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a quiet, professional workspace.

- Ability to work consistently during the scheduled US Central Time hours.

- Strong attention to detail and willingness to take ownership of responsibilities.

Preferred, but not required:

- Experience working with US-based home service businesses.

- Experience with Jobber or similar field service management software.

- Experience with customer relationship management (CRM) systems.

- Previous sales, lead conversion, or appointment-setting experience.

- Familiarity with basic residential maintenance and repair services.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who:

- Enjoys speaking with customers and solving problems.

- Understands that answering an inquiry is only the beginning; booking the job is the goal.

- Can manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed.

- Follows procedures but knows when to ask questions.

- Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Communicates clearly and proactively.

- Wants a stable, long-term working relationship.

We're particularly interested in candidates who can balance excellent customer service with the ability to confidently guide customers toward booking appointments.

Compensation & Benefits

- $5–$7 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- Consistent, full-time schedule of 40 hours per week.

- Eight paid personal days annually.

- Paid holidays when our company is closed for designated US holidays.

- Compensation and performance review after 90 days.

- Paid training and comprehensive operating procedures.

- Opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation as the company grows.

This is a dedicated full-time position. You must be available exclusively for The Denton Handyman during scheduled working hours. Outside work is permitted outside those hours.

How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. Your current resume.

2. A brief introduction describing your relevant experience.

We look forward to hearing from you!
